items.title: 〈焦點股〉智邦投信連買力挺Q4走強 早盤反彈觸及漲停1350元
items.title_en: Focus Stock: ZhiBang Investment Trust Continues Buying Supporting Q4 Strength; Early Session Rally Hits Upper Limit at 1,350 TWD
paras: 網通股王智邦(2345-TW)今(23)日在台北股市展現強勁反彈氣勢，擺脫先前連續2個交易日累計下跌13.38%的回檔走勢，今日早盤以1235元開出後雖一度下探1200元低點，隨即在買盤湧入下震盪走高並強攻漲停價1350元。
投信法人近日積極回補智邦，已連續4個交易日買超共計2357張，雖然外資上週賣超799張，但合計三大法人上週仍買超1906張。受惠於AI資料中心需求持續強勁，法人看好在亞馬遜旗下AWS Trainium 3晶片及客戶的800G交換器出貨放量帶動下，智邦2026年第4季營運可望再攀高峰，營收獲利可望持續走揚。
展望2027年中長期營運動能與產業趨勢，法人預期雲端巨頭亞馬遜明年資本支出將顯著高於今年的2200億美元，持續為AI基礎設施供應鏈挹注龐大需求。智邦除穩居高階交換器與AI加速器模組核心供應鏈外，亦同步積極布局光學電路交換器OCS與共同封裝光學CPO等次世代高速傳輸技術，中長期成長動能可期。
paras_en: Network communications leader ZhiBang (2345‑TW) showed a strong rebound in today’s Taipei market, shedding the cumulative 13.38% decline over the previous two trading days. After opening at TWD 1,235 in the early session and briefly dipping to a low of TWD 1,200, buying pressure quickly lifted the stock, driving it up to the daily limit price of TWD 1,350.

Investment trusts have been actively rebuilding positions in ZhiBang, buying a net total of 2,357 lots over the past four trading days. Although foreign investors sold 799 lots last week, the three major institutional investors still posted a net purchase of 1,906 lots for the week. Benefiting from sustained strong demand for AI data centers, institutions are optimistic that ZhiBang’s Q4 2026 operations will climb higher, with revenue and profit expected to keep rising, driven by Amazon‑owned AWS Trainium 3 chips and the scaling up of customers’ 800 Gbps switch shipments.

Looking ahead to mid‑to‑long‑term momentum in 2027 and industry trends, institutions expect Amazon’s capital expenditures next year to far exceed this year’s US$220 billion, continuously fueling massive demand for AI infrastructure. In addition to maintaining a solid position in high‑end switches and AI accelerator modules, ZhiBang is actively developing next‑generation high‑speed transmission technologies such as optical circuit switches (OCS) and co‑packaged optics (CPO), positioning the company for sustained growth.

items.title: 共信-KY動物腫瘤新藥取得台灣藥證 將啟動銷售
items.title_en: Gongxin-KY Secures Taiwan Drug Approval for New Veterinary Oncology Drug, Prepares for Sales
paras: 共信-KY(6617-TW)今(23)日宣布，旗下伴侶動物抗腫瘤新藥「思沛康注射液(Gwa103)」已取得台灣農業部動植物防疫檢疫署核發的動物用藥品許可證，即將在台灣啟動商業銷售。
共信-KY指出，思沛康核心成分為甲苯磺醯胺(p-TSA)，採用公司開發的IDA(瘤內藥物消融)技術，透過將藥物直接注射至實體腫瘤內部，促使腫瘤組織壞死。相較於傳統全身性給藥方式，IDA可結合超音波、電腦斷層等影響導引技術，提高施藥精準度，減少對周邊正常組織的影響。
總經理林懋元指出，對於部分不適合接受大範圍手術，或希望盡可能保留肢體與器官功能的病犬，可望提供另一選擇。他並指出，此次取證開創結合瘤內藥物消融與影像導引技術，治療犬隻黑色素瘤的開發模式。
至於台灣市場現況，根據農業部2024年公布的調查資料，2023年台灣家庭飼養犬貓比例已達28.3%，相當於每3至4戶家庭就有1戶飼養犬貓。
不過共信-KY今天走勢震盪，早盤以95.3元開高，盤中最高漲至98.7元，漲幅超過4%，隨後翻黑走低，截至10點30分，股價暫報91.3元，跌逾3%，回測年線，成交量約700張。
paras_en: Gongxin-KY (6617-TW) announced today (23rd) that its new companion animal anti-tumor drug "Gwa103" has obtained a veterinary drug license issued by Taiwan's Ministry of Agriculture, Animal and Plant Health Inspection and Quarantine, and will soon begin commercial sales in Taiwan.

Gongxin-KY explained that the core ingredient of Gwa103 is p‑TSA (p‑toluenesulfonamide), and it uses the company’s proprietary IDA (intratumoral drug ablation) technology to inject the drug directly into solid tumors, inducing tumor necrosis. Compared with conventional systemic administration, IDA can be combined with ultrasound, CT, and other image‑guidance techniques to improve drug delivery precision and reduce impact on surrounding normal tissues.

General Manager Lin Mao‑yuan noted that for dogs that are not suitable for extensive surgery or wish to preserve limb and organ function as much as possible, this offers an alternative. He added that this approval marks a pioneering model that combines intratumoral drug ablation with image guidance for treating canine melanoma.

Regarding the current Taiwan market, data released by the Ministry of Agriculture in 2024 shows that in 2023 the proportion of households owning dogs or cats reached 28.3%, meaning roughly one in every three to four households owns a dog or cat.

However, Gongxin-KY’s stock was volatile today: it opened at 95.3 NTD, peaked at 98.7 NTD (up over 4%) before falling sharply. By 10:30 a.m., the price was 91.3 NTD, down over 3%, retracing the yearly line, with a trading volume of about 700 shares.

items.title: OpenAI提議為AI發展設共同限制！盼以「困惑度」衡量模型進展、奧特曼支持
items.title_en: OpenAI Proposes Common Restrictions for AI Development! Hopes to Measure Model Progress with Perplexity, Supported by Altman
paras: 隨著人工智慧（AI）模型能力快速提升，OpenAI 首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 提出，業界應建立共同的模型發展限制，並採用「困惑度」（Perplexity）作為衡量AI進展的通用指標。這項提議獲得OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）支持。
根據《路透》報導，Pachocki 周日（22日）在部落格文章中指出，AI開發商應就模型能力設定共同門檻，並承諾在業界對AI行為的理解與監控能力達到具體里程碑前，不讓模型跨越相關限制。
他認為，這些門檻除了依據困惑度，也應納入其他衡量指標。
Pachocki 將困惑度描述為衡量模型智慧程度的指標，評估模型平均預測下一個token的能力。token是資料的基本單位；困惑度愈低，代表模型的預測能力愈好。
Pachocki 指出，AI最快可能在2027年便協助推動AI訓練方法的根本性進展，進而使技術發展速度超越監控與安全機制的進步。
他表示，在新的監控與安全機制到位之前，開發商應承諾不跨越業界商定的模型能力門檻。
Pachocki 主張，業界應制定一套共同標準，明確規範AI開發的第一道限制，以及在突破該限制前必須達成哪些里程碑。
奧特曼支持這項提議，並在社群平台X發文表示，業界應尋求就AI發展的共同限制達成共識。他形容帕喬基的文章是「OpenAI一段時間以來發布過最重要的內容」，並指出這類限制有助於確保AI的安全與可控性。
paras_en: With AI models rapidly improving, OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has suggested that the industry establish shared limits on model development and use perplexity as a universal metric for measuring AI progress. The proposal has received backing from OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.

According to Reuters, Pachocki wrote in a blog post on Sunday (22nd) that AI developers should set common thresholds for model capability and agree not to exceed those limits until the industry reaches concrete milestones in understanding and monitoring AI behavior.
He believes that these thresholds should include perplexity as well as other metrics.

Pachocki describes perplexity as a measure of a model’s intelligence, evaluating how well it can predict the next token on average. A token is the basic unit of data; lower perplexity indicates better predictive ability.
Pachocki points out that AI could soon, possibly by 2027, drive fundamental advances in training methods, potentially outpacing progress in monitoring and safety mechanisms.
He states that until new monitoring and safety mechanisms are in place, developers should commit not to cross the industry-agreed capability thresholds.

Pachocki argues that the industry should create a set of common standards that clearly define the first restriction on AI development and specify the milestones that must be achieved before breaking that barrier.

Altman supports the proposal and posted on X that the industry should seek consensus on common restrictions for AI development. He called Pachocki’s article “the most important content OpenAI has released in a long time” and noted that such limits help ensure AI safety and controllability.

items.title: 簽約訂單重新報價！戴爾、惠普、聯想及美超微等AI伺服器廠要求最高漲價45%
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，戴爾、惠普企業(HPE)、聯想及美超微(Super Micro)等廠商正要求客戶為已簽訂的AI伺服器訂單支付更高價格，部分訂單漲幅達25%至45%。這些AI伺服器通常搭載輝達或超微GPU及記憶體晶片、網路設備等零組件，供應商給出的理由是記憶體成本飆升和電路板短缺。
漲價主要推手是記憶體。根據摩根大通研究，自2024年初以來，記憶體價格累計上漲超過400%；伺服器DRAM合約價光是今年第一季就上漲約90%。
HPE執行長Antonio Neri更指出，現今的記憶體價格已超過一台伺服器物料成本的一半。
受影響客戶包括全球知名量化交易機構Jane Street、Optiver和Hudson River Trading，這些機構正建造大型資料中心，為交易策略研究提供算力支援。
知情人士透露，搭載GPU的AI伺服器價格至少上漲20%至30%，而記憶體成本佔比較高的CPU，價格已漲至原來的三倍甚至更高。此外，全球電路板短缺料將持續到2028年。
報導也提及，相關漲價發生在合約簽署數月後，增加了金融交易機構等客戶的資料中心建置成本。量化交易公司XTX Markets因一筆價值5.49億美元的戴爾伺服器訂單發生價格爭議，已在愛爾蘭起訴戴爾。XTX表示，戴爾要求在原合約金額之外追加約6200萬至7000萬美元費用，戴爾則稱無法自行承擔零件成本上漲。

items.title: 南韓「救市」！或是2008年金融危機後首度啟動股市穩定基金
paras: 南韓股市遭遇沉重賣壓，政府決定提前部署救市措施。南韓副總理兼財政部長 Lee Hyoung-il 周日（22日）主持金融市場緊急會議後宣布，政府將立即啟動股市穩定基金的動用準備工作，並放寬上市公司庫藏股申報限制，同時加強打擊非法放空，試圖緩解市場賣壓。
這是2008年全球金融危機以來，南韓股市穩定基金第三度進入啟動準備階段，也是首次自2008年實際動用後，再度正式展開啟動準備。政府表示，將視市場情況決定是否動用基金。
相關措施將陸續實施：上市公司每日庫藏股申報量上限自11月24日起放寬，為期三個月；金融監督院（FSS）與南韓交易所也將同步展開為期三個月的非法放空專案監控。
南韓政府此次出手，主要是因為韓股20日重挫逾5%，同日美國那斯達克指數也下跌5.28%。官員認為，全球AI產業面臨政策風險升高、獲利與融資前景不確定、美國資料中心監管趨嚴，以及半導體出口管制加強等多重壓力，市場疑慮持續升溫。
此外，外資持續撤出、企業庫藏股買盤也有減弱跡象，進一步加重市場壓力，使南韓股市面臨愈來愈大的「賣出韓國」賣壓。

股市穩定基金重啟準備 2008年後首見

南韓股市穩定基金是政府用來填補股市流動性缺口的政策工具。2008年全球金融危機期間，南韓交易所等機構於當年10月籌設規模5,150億韓元的基金，並從11月起按月進場買股，持續至2009年3月。
此後，南韓政府曾在2020年及2022年兩度啟動基金準備程序，但最終都未實際進場。此次則是2008年以來，政府首次再次正式展開啟動準備工作。
政府表示，將立即檢視基金啟動機制，確保能依市場情勢迅速部署，並研究提升基金運作效率的配套措施。
不過，與會官員也強調，儘管近期市場波動加劇，AI產業中長期成長前景仍具合理性，投資人不應過度恐慌或跟風拋售。

放寬庫藏股限制 加強監控非法放空

除了準備動用穩定基金，南韓政府也將放寬企業庫藏股申報限制。自11月24日起，未來三個月內，上市公司每日申報買回自家股票的數量上限將予以調整。
原有規定限制企業每日申報買回量，不得超過預定回購總量的10%與過去一個月日均成交量25%兩者中的較大值，且不得超過公司總股本的1%。
此次放寬限制，目的是增加企業買回自家股票的操作空間，在市場下跌時提供更多買盤支撐。近期企業庫藏股一直是吸收外資賣壓的重要力量，但部分大型企業的回購計畫接近尾聲，市場開始擔心承接力道減弱。
在放空監管方面，金融監督院與南韓交易所將聯手展開為期三個月的強化監控，嚴格處置查獲的非法放空行為。
政府也將密切追蹤信用貸款、融資交易及強制平倉情況，避免連鎖賣壓擴大，並同步強化強制平倉預告等投資人保護措施。

外資持續撤出 韓股陷「賣出韓國」壓力

根據《路透》報導，南韓股市正面臨持續性的外資撤離潮，外資淨流出已延續數月，累計規模創LSEG資料紀錄新高。市場當前的主要問題，在於買盤持續萎縮，難以消化賣壓。
值得注意的是，三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 等AI晶片主要企業獲利屢創新高，也推出規模龐大的股東回報計畫，但股市表現與企業基本面卻持續背離。
分析人士指出，韓股目前面臨的壓力，更多來自買盤不足，而非企業基本面惡化。
Kiwoom證券分析師Han Jiyoung表示，市場基本上正經歷全面性的「賣出韓國」趨勢，當前挑戰在於尋找能夠吸引外資回流的催化因素。
在外資持續撤出、買盤支撐轉弱之際，南韓政府推出一系列穩定措施，試圖阻止市場賣壓進一步擴大。官員則重申，AI產業中長期基本面並未出現根本性變化，認為市場目前的恐慌情緒可能過度。

items.title: 〈台股開盤〉多空激戰高低震盪1200點 聯發科、聯電扮多頭先鋒
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Opens Amid Fierce Battle, Volatility Exceeds 1,200 Points, MediaTek and UMC Lead Bulls
paras: 美股上週五重挫，但美股期貨今日開盤後呈現反彈走高，加上政府加大護盤措施，台股今(23)日多空交戰，開盤後雖然一度下跌590點，但隨後翻紅漲逾600點，高低震盪逾1200點，預估成交量則暫時來到1.2兆元。
台積電今日開低1990元，下跌10元或0.5%，盤中雖然一度漲逾2%，但在賣壓出籠下，早盤暫在平盤2000元附近震盪，台達電、聯發科早盤則漲約半根停板，智邦、聯電更一度攻上漲停。
千金股漲跌互見，信驊高低震盪900元，震幅逾10%，智邦一度攻上漲停板，世芯-KY衝上漲停，貿聯-KY也逼近漲停價，不過，創意早盤跌停、穎崴、大立光、奇鋐、鴻勁等均跌約半根停板。
ABF載板三雄則持續走弱，景碩早盤跌停、欣興及南電也跌逾9%，其餘PCB族群表現同樣弱勢，健策早盤一度跌停、聯茂跌逾9%、華通跌8%、台玻也跌6%，台光電雖然早盤也跌逾9%，但隨後走高翻紅漲逾3%。
paras_en: U.S. stocks plunged last Friday, but U.S. futures rebounded sharply after opening today, and with the government stepping up protective measures, the Taiwan market saw a fierce battle today. After an initial drop of 590 points, it later surged over 600 points, swinging more than 1,200 points in total, with an estimated trading volume of about 1.2 trillion TWD.

TSMC opened at 1,990 TWD today, down 10 TWD or 0.5%. Although it rose over 2% during the day, selling pressure pushed it back, and it hovered near 2,000 TWD in the early session. Delta Electronics and MediaTek both rose about half a point in the early session, while Chih-Bang and UMC briefly hit their daily upper limits.

The high‑value stocks showed mixed moves: ShinHua oscillated 900 TWD, a swing of over 10%; Chih‑Bang briefly hit its upper limit, while Shih‑Chin‑KY and Mao‑Lian‑KY approached their limits. However, Chuang‑Yi fell to its lower limit early, and Ying‑Wei, Lide‑Kao, Qi‑Huang, and Hong‑Jing all fell about half a point.

ABF’s three major substrate companies continued to weaken: Jing‑Shuo fell to its lower limit early, while Xin‑Xing and Nan‑Dian fell over 9%. Other PCB groups performed similarly weakly; Jian‑Ce fell to its lower limit early, Lian‑Mao fell over 9%, Hua‑Tong fell 8%, and Taiwan‑Glass fell 6%. Taiwan‑Light‑Electronics fell over 9% early, but later rebounded and rose over 3%.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉普鴻推進後量子密碼遷移 股價亮漲停燈
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Puhong Advances Post-Quantum Cryptography Migration, Shares Hit Daily Limit
paras: 財團法人資訊工業策進會發表《台灣金融及關鍵產業 PQC 遷移實務白皮書》(從 CBOM 盤點到加密敏捷性部署)，普鴻資訊(6590-TW)參與撰寫，範圍涵蓋金融與關鍵產業最常面臨的PQC遷移落地挑戰，在資安的長期成長趨勢下，今(23)日早盤股價再度攻上漲停。
普鴻表示，此次白皮書結合政策觀察、國際標準與本土實務經驗，提供完整且可操作的後量子密碼(PQC)遷移指引，其中，第三至第五章聚焦實務做法，由普鴻撰寫；普鴻認為，金融與關鍵產業對系統可用性與合規要求極高，PQC遷移不宜採一次性大改，而應透過盤點、風險排序、加密敏捷性建置與分階段部署，逐步完成轉型。
在此白皮書第三章中，普鴻提出以加密資產清冊(CBOM)為核心的盤點與風險評估方法論，協助機構系統性掌握金鑰、憑證、協定與演算法現況，並結合量子風險與遷移難度進行優先順序排序。
第四章說明雙軌平滑遷移策略與加密敏捷性架構設計，強調透過參數化與模組化設計，以及集中化加密服務(如 CLM、EKM、CaaS)降低應用程式與演算法的耦合程度，使未來演算法替換不需大規模改寫系統。
而第五章則針對實施部署與持續維運提出具體作業流程，包含混合模式(Hybrid)過渡、驗證監控、逐步轉為純 PQC，以及建立持續監控與 PDCA 循環的機制。

paras_en: Tengshi, a Taiwanese health and wellness product developer (ticker 7889-TW), is priced at NT$47.19 per share. Today, the 23rd, is the last day for public subscription before the OTC listing; the company will conduct a public lottery on November 25, and the shares will trade on the OTC on December 1.

With a focus on essential product categories, multi‑brand precision marketing, and high inventory turnover, the gross margin was 68.81%. items.title: 〈焦點股〉智邦投信連買力挺Q4走強 早盤反彈觸及漲停1350元
items.title_en: Focus Stock: ZhiBang Investment Trust Continues Buying Supporting Q4 Strength; Early Session Rally Hits Upper Limit at 1,350 TWD
paras: 網通股王智邦(2345-TW)今(23)日在台北股市展現強勁反彈氣勢，擺脫先前連續2個交易日累計下跌13.38%的回檔走勢，今日早盤以1235元開出後雖一度下探1200元低點，隨即在買盤湧入下震盪走高並強攻漲停價1350元。

paras_en: Network communications leader ZhiBang (2345‑TW) showed a strong rebound in today’s Taipei market, shedding the cumulative 13.38% decline over the previous two trading days. After opening at TWD 1,235 in the early session and briefly dipping to a low of TWD 1,200, buying pressure quickly lifted the stock, driving it up to the daily limit price of TWD 1,350.

Investment trusts have been actively rebuilding positions in ZhiBang, buying a net total of 2,357 lots over the past four trading days. Although foreign investors sold 799 lots last week, the three major institutional investors still posted a net purchase of 1,906 lots for the week. Benefiting from sustained strong demand for AI data centers, institutions are optimistic that ZhiBang’s Q4 2026 operations will climb higher, with revenue and profit expected to keep rising, driven by Amazon‑owned AWS Trainium 3 chips and the scaling up of customers’ 800 Gbps switch shipments.

items.title: 共信-KY動物腫瘤新藥取得台灣藥證 將啟動銷售
items.title_en: Gongxin-KY Secures Taiwan Drug Approval for New Veterinary Oncology Drug, Prepares for Sales
paras: 共信-KY(6617-TW)今(23)日宣布，旗下伴侶動物抗腫瘤新藥「思沛康注射液(Gwa103)」已取得台灣農業部動植物防疫檢疫署核發的動物用藥品許可證，即將在台灣啟動商業銷售。

不過共信-KY今天走勢震盪，早盤以95.3元開高，盤中最高漲至98.7元，漲幅超過4%，隨後翻黑走低，截至10點30分，股價暫報91.3元，跌逾3%，回測年線，成交量約700張。
paras_en: Gongxin-KY (6617-TW) announced today (23rd) that its new companion animal anti-tumor drug "Gwa103" has obtained a veterinary drug license issued by Taiwan's Ministry of Agriculture, Animal and Plant Health Inspection and Quarantine, and will soon begin commercial sales in Taiwan.

Gongxin-KY explained that the core ingredient of Gwa103 is p‑TSA (p‑toluenesulfonamide), and it uses the company’s proprietary IDA (intratumoral drug ablation) technology to inject the drug directly into solid tumors, inducing tumor necrosis. Compared with conventional systemic administration, IDA can be combined with ultrasound, CT, and other image‑guidance techniques to improve drug delivery precision and reduce impact on surrounding normal tissues.

General Manager Lin Mao‑yuan noted that for dogs that are not suitable for extensive surgery or wish to preserve limb and organ function as much as possible, this offers an alternative. He added that this approval marks a pioneering model that combines intratumoral drug ablation with image guidance for treating canine melanoma.

Regarding the current Taiwan market, data released by the Ministry of Agriculture in 2024 shows that in 2023 the proportion of households owning dogs or cats reached 28.3%, meaning roughly one in every three to four households owns a dog or cat.

However, Gongxin-KY’s stock was volatile today: it opened at 95.3 NTD, peaked at 98.7 NTD (up over 4%) before falling sharply. By 10:30 a.m., the price was 91.3 NTD, down over 3%, retracing the yearly line, with a trading volume of about 700 shares.

美國財政部長貝森特日前表示輝達董事會應從外部找新執行長，但昨日卻鬆口表態，黃仁勳現在已是「外部人士」，態度急轉彎令市場解讀，此說法是不排除黃仁勳回鍋輝達的可能性，市場密切關注黃仁勳將於12月1日赴美國參議院出席聽證會。
消息也使今日台股恐慌情緒緩和，台積電力守2000元上，聯發科、聯電、台達電(2308-TW)、華碩(2357-TW)、智邦等翻紅，再加上大型傳產股如長榮(2603-TW)、統一(1216-TW)等也發揮穩盤效果。
統一投顧分析，台股短線面臨籌碼快速去槓桿的震盪，目前上市融資餘額自10月6日高點以來已大減31.7%，超越大盤同期27.6%的跌幅，配合金管會禁空令3.0新制上路，下檔有望逐步築底，惟須留意，短線外資提款與融資斷頭餘波尚未完全平息，建議不恐慌殺低也不貿然重倉摸底，靜待大盤出現爆量下影線，分批鎖定具技術護城河的大型龍頭股、高殖利率概念股和防禦性族群。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market faced a looming storm today (the 23rd), but early‑session policy support took effect. Coupled with U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen’s sudden reversal on Jensen Huang’s possible return to Nvidia, the market was spurred into a rally, while margin‑trading positions continued to be liquidated. Major heavyweight stocks rallied in defense, including MediaTek (2454‑TW), United Microelectronics (2303‑TW), Formosa Plastics Corp. (6505‑TW), Chipbond Technology (2345‑TW), Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW), ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW), Quanta Computer (2382‑TW) and others, all posting gains. TSMC (2330‑TW) also kept fighting to hold the NT$2,000 level.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently said Nvidia’s board should look outside for a new CEO, but yesterday she softened her stance, noting that Jensen Huang is now an “outside person.” The abrupt turn led the market to interpret that a return for Huang to Nvidia is not ruled out. Investors are closely watching Huang’s scheduled appearance before the U.S. Senate on December 1 for a hearing.

The news also eased today’s panic sentiment in Taiwan’s market. TSMC continued to defend the NT$2,000 mark, while MediaTek, UMC, Delta Electronics (2308‑TW), ASUS (2357‑TW), Chipbond and others turned red. In addition, large traditional‑industry stocks such as Evergreen Marine (2603‑TW) and Uni-President (1216‑TW) contributed to market stability.

Analysts at Uni-President Securities note that the Taiwan market faces short‑term volatility as capital is rapidly deleveraged. Since the October 6 peak, outstanding margin financing has shrunk by 31.7%, outpacing the overall market’s 27.6% decline. With the Financial Supervisory Commission’s new short‑selling ban (Version 3.0) now in force, the lower end of the market may gradually form a base. However, short‑term foreign outflows and the after‑effects of margin calls have not fully subsided. They advise against panic‑selling or aggressively loading positions; instead, wait for a high‑volume down‑trend candle before gradually locking in large‑cap leaders with strong technical moats, high‑yield concepts, and defensive sectors.

items.title: OpenAI提議為AI發展設共同限制！盼以「困惑度」衡量模型進展、奧特曼支持
items.title_en: OpenAI Proposes Common Restrictions for AI Development! Hopes to Measure Model Progress with Perplexity, Supported by Altman
paras: 隨著人工智慧（AI）模型能力快速提升，OpenAI 首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 提出，業界應建立共同的模型發展限制，並採用「困惑度」（Perplexity）作為衡量AI進展的通用指標。這項提議獲得OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）支持。
根據《路透》報導，Pachocki 周日（22日）在部落格文章中指出，AI開發商應就模型能力設定共同門檻，並承諾在業界對AI行為的理解與監控能力達到具體里程碑前，不讓模型跨越相關限制。
他認為，這些門檻除了依據困惑度，也應納入其他衡量指標。
Pachocki 將困惑度描述為衡量模型智慧程度的指標，評估模型平均預測下一個token的能力。token是資料的基本單位；困惑度愈低，代表模型的預測能力愈好。
Pachocki 指出，AI最快可能在2027年便協助推動AI訓練方法的根本性進展，進而使技術發展速度超越監控與安全機制的進步。
他表示，在新的監控與安全機制到位之前，開發商應承諾不跨越業界商定的模型能力門檻。
Pachocki 主張，業界應制定一套共同標準，明確規範AI開發的第一道限制，以及在突破該限制前必須達成哪些里程碑。
奧特曼支持這項提議，並在社群平台X發文表示，業界應尋求就AI發展的共同限制達成共識。他形容帕喬基的文章是「OpenAI一段時間以來發布過最重要的內容」，並指出這類限制有助於確保AI的安全與可控性。
paras_en: With AI models rapidly improving, OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has suggested that the industry establish shared limits on model development and use perplexity as a universal metric for measuring AI progress. The proposal has received backing from OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.

According to Reuters, Pachocki wrote in a blog post on Sunday (22nd) that AI developers should set common thresholds for model capability and agree not to exceed those limits until the industry reaches concrete milestones in understanding and monitoring AI behavior.
He believes that these thresholds should include perplexity as well as other metrics.

Pachocki describes perplexity as a measure of a model’s intelligence, evaluating how well it can predict the next token on average. A token is the basic unit of data; lower perplexity indicates better predictive ability.
Pachocki points out that AI could soon, possibly by 2027, drive fundamental advances in training methods, potentially outpacing progress in monitoring and safety mechanisms.
He states that until new monitoring and safety mechanisms are in place, developers should commit not to cross the industry-agreed capability thresholds.

Pachocki argues that the industry should create a set of common standards that clearly define the first restriction on AI development and specify the milestones that must be achieved before breaking that barrier.

Altman supports the proposal and posted on X that the industry should seek consensus on common restrictions for AI development. He called Pachocki’s article “the most important content OpenAI has released in a long time” and noted that such limits help ensure AI safety and controllability.

items.title: 簽約訂單重新報價！戴爾、惠普、聯想及美超微等AI伺服器廠要求最高漲價45%
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，戴爾、惠普企業(HPE)、聯想及美超微(Super Micro)等廠商正要求客戶為已簽訂的AI伺服器訂單支付更高價格，部分訂單漲幅達25%至45%。這些AI伺服器通常搭載輝達或超微GPU及記憶體晶片、網路設備等零組件，供應商給出的理由是記憶體成本飆升和電路板短缺。
漲價主要推手是記憶體。根據摩根大通研究，自2024年初以來，記憶體價格累計上漲超過400%；伺服器DRAM合約價光是今年第一季就上漲約90%。
HPE執行長Antonio Neri更指出，現今的記憶體價格已超過一台伺服器物料成本的一半。
受影響客戶包括全球知名量化交易機構Jane Street、Optiver和Hudson River Trading，這些機構正建造大型資料中心，為交易策略研究提供算力支援。
知情人士透露，搭載GPU的AI伺服器價格至少上漲20%至30%，而記憶體成本佔比較高的CPU，價格已漲至原來的三倍甚至更高。此外，全球電路板短缺料將持續到2028年。
報導也提及，相關漲價發生在合約簽署數月後，增加了金融交易機構等客戶的資料中心建置成本。量化交易公司XTX Markets因一筆價值5.49億美元的戴爾伺服器訂單發生價格爭議，已在愛爾蘭起訴戴爾。XTX表示，戴爾要求在原合約金額之外追加約6200萬至7000萬美元費用，戴爾則稱無法自行承擔零件成本上漲。

items.title: 川普：美股市值蒸發超過6兆美元　100%怪民主黨
items.title_en: Trump: US Stock Market Lost Over $6 Trillion, 100% Blames Democrats
paras: 美國總統川普周日(22日)把美股市值近來蒸發逾6兆美元，歸咎於民主黨在11月3日期中選舉後重掌國會，並安撫市場稱「國家很快就會重新強大起來」。
他在Truth Social發文說，「自民主黨那場相當奇怪的『勝利』以來，市場已下跌超過6兆美元，單是那斯達克就跌了20%」，並批評民主黨推行「反增長、只圖報復」的政策。

美股三大指數上周五(20日)集體重挫；道瓊大跌1.93%、連跌第五日收在48147.33點；標普500挫跌3.7%、連跌第七日創2020年以來最長連跌紀錄，收6910.39點；那斯達克指數跌5.28%，收22617.73點，吐光今年所有漲幅。以周線計，道指累跌8.02%、標普累跌8.61%、那指累跌10.02%、那指100累跌10.43%。晶片股更迎來2001年9月以來最差一周，輝達市值自今年10月6日高點以來蒸發約2.7兆美元。
但市場解讀股災並非單一因素造成。美國財長貝森特周日表示，拋售「是多種因素疊加」，早在民主黨民調領先時就已啟動，選後加速。投資者憂慮民主黨在「超級智能(SI)」建設上的立場會拖慢資料中心與AI擴張步伐，加上Fed接連放出鷹派言論，市場擔心政策過度收緊釀成失誤。川普上周五亦再度炮轟Fed利率過高、決策帶「政治屬性」。
知名科技分析師艾夫斯(Dan Ives)則把上周形容為科技股的「完美風暴」，民主黨壓倒性勝選可能帶來AI與資料中心監管政策緊縮，加上黃仁勳從輝達離職，雙重衝擊集中引爆。
paras_en: US President Donald Trump on Sunday (the 22nd) said the US stock market has recently evaporated more than $6 trillion in value, blaming the Democrats for regaining control of Congress after the November 3 midterm elections, and he tried to reassure the market that “the country will soon be strong again.”

He posted on Truth Social that “since the Democrats’ rather odd ‘victory,’ the market has dropped over $6 trillion, with the Nasdaq alone down 20%,” and criticized the Democrats for pursuing “anti‑growth, revenge‑focused” policies.

The three major US indexes all slumped on Friday (the 20th): the Dow fell 1.93% for the fifth consecutive day to 48,147.33 points; the S&P 500 dropped 3.7%, marking a seven‑day losing streak—the longest since 2020—and closed at 6,910.39; the Nasdaq fell 5.28% to 22,617.73, wiping out all gains made this year. On a weekly basis the Dow is down 8.02%, the S&P 8.61%, the Nasdaq 10.02% and the Nasdaq‑100 10.43%. Chip stocks suffered their worst week since September 2001, with Nvidia’s market cap shedding about $2.7 trillion since its October 6 peak this year.

But market analysts say the crash is not due to a single factor. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen said on Sunday that the sell‑off “is the result of multiple overlapping factors,” noting that selling began when Democrats were already leading in the polls and accelerated after the election. Investors worry that Democratic policies on “super‑intelligence (SI)” could slow data‑center and AI expansion, and hawkish Fed comments have raised fears of overly tight policy. Trump also lashed out again on Friday, calling Fed rates too high and accusing the Fed’s decisions of having a “political character.”

Well‑known tech analyst Dan Ives described last week as a “perfect storm” for tech stocks: an overwhelming Democratic win could tighten AI and data‑center regulation, and Nvidia’s co‑founder Jensen Huang’s departure adds a double blow that ignited the sell‑off.

paras: 美股三大股指期貨在亞股周一(23日)早盤交易階段齊步開高，截至台灣時間周一早上8時52分，那斯達克100期指上漲2.83%，標普500期指漲2.11%，道指期漲1.4%。現貨黃金日內漲逾1%，收復每盎司36000美元大關，現貨白銀上漲2%重返42美元大關。
今年7月中旬以來，美股三大股指期貨持續走跌，科技股與半導體股遭大幅拋售，地緣政治風險與AI投資回報疑慮成為主要拖累因素，那指期貨領跌且跌幅顯著大於道指期貨。
亞股方面，日本股市因國定假日休市一天，南韓綜合股指(KOSPI)周一開盤下跌2.77%，此後跌幅擴大至4%，跌破4700點，SK海力士下跌4%，三星電子下跌4.7%。台灣加權指數周一開盤下跌425.82點，跌幅1.18%，報35607.47點，富時中國A50指數期貨開價0.06%。
在美股持續回檔後，華爾街開始密集尋找「底部訊號」，市場情緒被形容為「非常脆弱」，但逢低買盤的苗頭已經出現。
美國財富管理與投資機構愛德華·瓊斯高級全球投資策略師Angelo Kourkafas指出，回撤大到一定程度總會吸引買家，但他更關注表面之下的動向，必需消費品等防禦類股近期表現突出，顯示避險氛圍濃厚。他也期待看到銀行、工業等對經濟敏感的族群轉強，作為情緒企穩的確認訊號。
Nationwide首席市場策略師Mark Hackett認為，這輪拋售已將估值重置至更具吸引力的水準，投資者情緒指標也跌到歷史上常視為買進訊號的區間，但短期內情緒化賣壓仍可能壓過機會主義買盤。
技術型態方面，投資管理機構State Street首席策略師Michael Arone正追蹤標普500成分股距52週高點的跌幅，以及個股同向波動程度，並指出相關指標已接近超賣但尚未極端。
Granite Wealth創辦人Bruce Zaro則指出，紐交所創新高與創新低個股數量對比的指標已發出觸底訊號，但高於50日均線的股票比例仍偏低，「我們正接近一個絕佳的逢低買入點」。
避險基金Cynosure Strategies負責人兼投資長Brian Smedley直言「市場向下已超調，就像今年稍早向上超調一樣」，認為拋售也許已接近尾聲，投資者終將重拾對AI需求的信心。
不過，高盛交易部門警告，投資人整體倉位仍偏高，市場尚未出現足以催生強勢反彈的大規模恐慌性拋盤。
paras_en: US stock index futures rose in tandem during the early Asian trading session on Monday (23rd), with the Nasdaq 100 futures up 2.83%, the S&P 500 futures up 2.11%, and the Dow futures up 1.4% as of 8:52 a.m. Taiwan time; spot gold gained over 1% intraday, reclaiming the $3,600 per ounce mark, while spot silver rose 2% to return to the $42 per ounce level.

Since mid-July, US stock index futures have continued to decline, with technology and semiconductor stocks heavily sold off; geopolitical risk and doubts over AI investment returns have become the main drag, causing the Nasdaq futures to lead the decline and fall significantly more than the Dow futures.

In Asia, Japan's market was closed for a national holiday, and South Korea's KOSPI fell 2.77% at the open, then widened to a 4% drop, breaking below 4,700 points; SK Hynix fell 4% and Samsung Electronics fell 4.7%. Taiwan's weighted index fell 425.82 points, a 1.18% decline, to 35,607.47, and the FTSE China A50 futures opened at 0.06%.
After the US continued to retreat, Wall Street began searching intensively for a “bottom signal,” with market sentiment described as “very fragile,” yet signs of buying at lows have already emerged.

Angelo Kourkafas, senior global investment strategist at Edward Jones Wealth Management and Investment, noted that a pullback of a certain magnitude will inevitably attract buyers, but he is more concerned with underlying trends; defensive consumer staples have recently performed strongly, indicating a robust hedging atmosphere. He also expects to see banks and industry, which are sensitive to the economy, strengthen as confirmation of stabilizing sentiment.

Mark Hackett, chief market strategist at Nationwide, believes this round of selling has reset valuations to a more attractive level, and investor sentiment indicators have fallen into a range historically viewed as a buying signal, but short‑term emotional selling pressure may still outweigh opportunistic buying.

From a technical perspective, Michael Arone, chief strategist at State Street, is tracking the decline of S&P 500 components from their 52‑week highs and the degree of co‑movement among individual stocks, noting that related indicators are approaching oversold but not yet extreme.

Bruce Zaro, founder of Granite Wealth, pointed out that the ratio of new highs to new lows on the NYSE has issued a bottom signal, yet the proportion of stocks above the 50‑day moving average remains low, stating, “We are approaching an excellent low‑buy point.”

Brian Smedley, head of Cynosure Strategies and chief investment officer, bluntly said, “The market has overreacted downwards, just as it overreacted upwards earlier this year,” suggesting that the selling may be nearing its end and investors will eventually regain confidence in AI demand.

However, Goldman Sachs' trading division cautioned that overall investor positions remain high, and the market has yet to experience the large‑scale panic selling necessary to trigger a strong rebound.

items.title: 監控恐趕不上模型進化！OpenAI疾呼同業設共同門檻：AI最快可能在2027年加速自我發展
paras: OpenAI首席科學家Jakub Pachocki周日(22日)發文呼籲全球AI企業建立行業統一標準，在研究人員具備更可靠的模型行為理解與監控能力之前，各家公司應承諾不突破約定的開發門檻。OpenAI執行長奧特曼公開表態支持，稱這是「OpenAI一段時間以來發表的最重要內容之一」。
Pachocki建議以「困惑度」（Perplexity）作為可跨企業追蹤的參考指標，該指標衡量模型預測下一段文本的能力，數值越低代表預測越強。
他公布OpenAI內部數據：GPT-3.5的對數困惑度約0.99，GPT-4約0.91；當指標降至0.8以下時，模型在網絡安全與數學領域浮現新能力；跌至約0.76時，已能在部分開放數學難題上取得突破。
Pachocki預估，一旦進入0.68至0.7區間，模型可能出現更多「變革性能力」，但目前無法確定具體形態。
最令Pachocki警惕的是時間差。Pachocki警告，AI最早可能在2027年推動預訓練技術出現一輪飛躍，速度可能超過研究人員在對齊與行為監控上的進展。「我們理解和監控AI行為的能力，未必追得上模型自我進化的節奏。」
因此，Pachocki提議AI業界應共同建立模型評測、透明度與安全紅隊測試標準，在模型首次投入使用前完成評估，並開發比現有思維鏈監控工具更先進的監測機制後，才允許突破下一道門檻。
但他也坦承困惑度並非完美指標：各企業訓練數據與評測集不同，數值難以直接橫向比較；該指標也無法涵蓋思維鏈推理等預訓練之外的技術進步，跨企業通用評測標準仍存技術難題。
奧特曼則在X平台上回應說：「若能就共同限制達成一致，將有助於確保安全與控制。」
與此同時，美國監管討論同步升溫。民主黨議員正醞釀下屆國會AI監管方案，科羅拉多州參議員John Hickenlooper提議設立參議院AI特別委員會，馬里蘭州參議員Chris Van Hollen表態支持；民主黨打算2027年1月取得國會多數後，將AI列為優先議題，涵蓋資料中心監管、安全標準、第三方評估等，但川普政府一貫反對限制AI開發施，白宮與國會監管路線分歧，料將成為下一輪政策博弈焦點。

items.title: 黃仁勳回鍋輝達現轉機？貝森特「改口」、仍追查中國業務出口管制疑雲
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）對黃仁勳重返輝達(NVDA-US) 執掌公司的可能性，態度似乎出現轉變。相較於先前主張輝達應大幅改組、由外部人士接任領導職務，貝森特最新談話並未排除黃仁勳回歸，為這位共同創辦人重新掌舵留下空間。
貝森特周日（22日）接受《CBS》節目 Face the Nation 訪問時表示，政府必須先釐清輝達相關違規行為的責任歸屬。他說：「我認為我們必須看看責任最終落在哪裡，以及公司底層有哪些從事惡意違規行為的人。」
他也透露，截至22日，美國財政部仍未收到輝達針對是否設立空殼公司規避出口管制的正式答覆，而政府要求的回覆期限為11月25日。
貝森特這次的說法，與他上周在《福斯新聞》節目中呼籲輝達進行「大幅整頓」，並主張下一任領導人應從公司外部尋找的強硬立場有所不同。
市場也開始反映黃仁勳回歸的可能性。預測市場平台Polymarket顯示，黃仁勳重新出任輝達執行長的機率，已從11月21日的11%升至14%。
貝森特上周曾公開要求輝達進行大幅改組，並表示這家AI晶片大廠的下一任領導人應由公司外部人士出任，當時被解讀為美國財政部不支持黃仁勳回鍋。
但在22日接受《CBS》訪問時，當主持人再次追問輝達是否應尋找外部人選領導公司，貝森特回答：「我說過他們（輝達）應該從外部找人，但他（黃仁勳）現在就在外部了。」
不過，貝森特強調，政府仍須釐清違規行為的責任層級，包括問題究竟出在基層、中階管理層，還是一路延伸至公司最高層。他也表示，有信心輝達各委員會能迅速完成調查，並提出可靠的結果。

川普支持黃仁勳回歸 董事會態度不同

黃仁勳是否重返輝達，也牽涉白宮與公司董事會之間的立場差異。
美國總統川普公開支持黃仁勳回歸，並呼籲輝達董事會讓這位30多年前的共同創辦人重新出任原職。黃仁勳的支持者也持續敦促董事會重新考慮相關決定。
然而，輝達董事會已明確表態，無意讓黃仁勳回歸，與川普的立場形成對照。
分析認為，如果董事會堅持不讓黃仁勳復職，向政府提交的調查答覆可能更傾向將責任歸於前任執行長；反之，若政府接受黃仁勳回歸，部分監管壓力可能因此降低。
貝森特最新談話讓這兩種可能性都尚未排除，但輝達對中國業務是否涉及違反出口管制的疑慮，仍有待釐清。
貝森特上周要求輝達在11月25日前向川普政府說明，公司是否曾設立空殼公司以規避出口管制。他22日再次確認，財政部目前尚未收到輝達的答覆。

items.title: 聯發科有望受惠！Google砍博通TPU訂單百萬顆、2027年出貨量下修20%
items.title_en: MediaTek Likely to Benefit as Google Cuts Broadcom TPU Orders by One Million Units, Reduces 2027 Shipments by 20%
paras: Google(GOOGL-US) 正重新調整人工智慧（AI）晶片採購策略，在資料中心電力供應與晶片產能受限之際，縮減博通(AVGO-US) 設計的高階張量處理器（TPU）訂單，轉而提高對聯發科(2454-TW) 設計晶片的採購量，反映Google正重新分配有限的運算資源。
蘋果(AAPL-US) 及供應鏈知名分析師郭明錤最新產業調查指出，Google已將博通設計的TPU 8i系列2027年出貨量下修約100萬顆，約占該系列全年預估出貨量的20%。其中，定價較高的8i Max（代號Whalefish）受到的影響最為明顯。
相較之下，Google計畫增加聯發科設計的TPU 8t系列採購量，但目前尚未確定具體增幅。
郭明錤指出，Google近幾個月多次強調，尖端模型的開發將優先取得運算資源。在資料中心電力供應及晶片產能雙雙受限的情況下，此次調整TPU 8i與8t系列的採購組合，正反映Google重新配置算力的方向。
在資源有限的環境下，Google傾向將高階算力集中用於尖端模型研發，而非持續擴大高價晶片的部署。尤其8i Max訂單遭到較大幅度削減，顯示Google也正重新權衡晶片採購成本與算力配置效益。
另一方面，增加TPU 8t系列採購量，則反映Google希望透過調整晶片組合，在電力與產能限制下維持算力部署。
這項策略調整可能對博通造成壓力。由於博通是Google TPU的主要設計合作夥伴，高階晶片訂單縮減恐衝擊其客製化晶片業務營收；相較之下，聯發科則可望藉由增加供貨，提升在Google AI基礎設施供應鏈中的比重。
paras_en: Google (GOOGL-US) is readjusting its AI chip procurement strategy, trimming orders for Broadcom (AVGO-US)-designed high-end Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) amid data center power constraints and chip capacity limits, while increasing purchases of MediaTek (2454-TW)-designed chips, reflecting a reallocation of limited compute resources.

Apple (AAPL-US) and analyst Ming-Chi Kuo’s latest industry survey indicates Google has cut the 2027 shipment volume of Broadcom’s TPU 8i series by about one million units, roughly 20% of the series’ annual forecast; the higher‑priced 8i Max (codename Whalefish) is most affected.
In contrast, Google plans to increase orders for MediaTek‑designed TPU 8t series, though the exact increase has not yet been determined.

Kuo notes that Google has repeatedly emphasized that development of cutting‑edge models will receive priority compute resources; with data center power and chip capacity both constrained, this adjustment of TPU 8i and 8t procurement reflects Google’s new compute allocation strategy.

In a resource‑scarce environment, Google prefers to concentrate high‑end compute on advanced model research rather than expanding deployment of expensive chips; the significant cut to 8i Max orders shows a reassessment of chip procurement cost versus compute efficiency.
Conversely, increasing TPU 8t orders indicates Google aims to maintain compute deployment by adjusting the chip mix under power and capacity limits.

This strategic shift could pressure Broadcom. As Google’s primary TPU design partner, Broadcom’s reduced high‑end chip orders may hit its custom chip revenue, while MediaTek stands to gain a larger share of Google’s AI infrastructure supply chain.

items.title: 美股今天恐重演「黑色星期一」？VIX飆近40、華爾街曝反彈訊號與潛在風險
paras: 美股周五（20日）遭遇猛烈拋售，部分散戶投資人開始擔憂，這周一（23日）股市恐重演1987年「黑色星期一」股災，甚至在美國感恩節假期前出現連續兩個「黑色交易日」。不過，華爾街對後市看法相對樂觀，認為恐慌指數（VIX）急升至40附近，反而可能意味著市場賣壓接近尾聲，為股市反彈創造條件。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，標普500指數上周五重挫3.7%，全周收低，正式進入修正區間，並連續下跌，創2020年以來最長紀錄。道瓊工業指數與那斯達克綜合指數當天也分別下跌1.9%與5.3%。
人工智慧（AI）相關股票成為這波跌勢的重災區。輝達(NVDA-US) 上周五股價暴跌14%，收在125.53美元，單周跌幅達23%。Anthropic(ANT-US) 股價則下跌8.5%，收在88.91美元；該股上周四上市首日收盤價為97.17美元，較每股83美元的首次公開發行（IPO）價格高出17%。
AI概念股遭遇猛烈拋售，也引發散戶投資社群對市場可能重演1987年股災的討論。1987年10月19日，全球股市爆發「黑色星期一」崩盤，道瓊工業指數單日重挫約23%。
在Reddit投資社群r/WallStreetBets上，有用戶指出，美國公債殖利率居高不下、AI泡沫疑慮、聯準會可能升息，以及被迫平倉等因素同時浮現，可能形成連鎖拋售的條件。
該用戶也表示，雖然不認為市場一定會重演1987年股災，但目前市場情勢愈來愈令人擔憂，投資人面臨的問題是，現在究竟已經出現買進機會，還是市場真正的恐慌性拋售尚未到來。
不過，華爾街的判斷與散戶對跌勢延續的憂慮有所不同。
華爾街相對樂觀的一項重要依據，是市場恐慌指標VIX周五盤中升至40，終場收在37.66，單日大漲32%。部分市場人士認為，恐慌情緒急遽升高，反而可能代表股票拋售潮正在接近尾聲。
Creative Planning首席市場策略師Charlie Bilello在社群平台X發文指出，從歷史經驗來看，VIX升至高點後，股市往往會反彈，後續報酬率也通常高於平均水準。
歷史數據顯示，當VIX恐慌指數升至40時，標普500指數在隨後6個月內有很高機率上漲約20%。
Bilello寫道：「恐懼是好事。」
Ironsides Macroeconomics管理合夥人Barry Knapp上周六（21日）發文表示，雖然「周五的收盤氣氛帶有投降式拋售的意味」，但股市未來幾天仍可能走高。
不過，市場能否維持反彈，仍是另一個問題。
Knapp認為，較可能出現的情境是，股市下周受惠於感恩節前後的季節性利多先行反彈，隨後在聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）利率決策日附近，再度測試低點，甚至小幅跌破前波低點。
從更長期的角度來看，Knapp認為，聯準會12月利率決策會議將是股市第一個可能出現的正面政策催化劑。在此之前，投資人情緒是短期內可能促使股市修正結束的另一項關鍵因素。
根據芝商所（CME）FedWatch工具，投資人普遍預期，FOMC將在12月8日至9日會議上，將聯邦基金利率目標區間調升至4%至4.25%。
不過，聯準會官員已釋出訊號，顯示目前仍在評估多種政策可能性。部分官員表示，傾向迅速採取行動抑制通膨；另一些官員則認為，隨著金融環境日益緊縮，以及市場對 AI 熱潮的疑慮升高，貨幣政策應採取更審慎的步調。
Knapp補充，目前他們仍維持充足現金部位，同時建議重新檢視整體投資風險，並選擇性評估是否動用現金進場布局。
整體而言，華爾街目前並未預期美股將重演黑色星期一式的崩盤，但市場仍存在不容忽視的風險與疑慮。

items.title: OpenAI提議為AI發展設共同限制！盼以「困惑度」衡量模型進展、奧特曼支持
items.title_en: OpenAI Proposes Common Restrictions for AI Development! Hopes to Measure Model Progress with Perplexity, Supported by Altman
paras: 隨著人工智慧（AI）模型能力快速提升，OpenAI 首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 提出，業界應建立共同的模型發展限制，並採用「困惑度」（Perplexity）作為衡量AI進展的通用指標。這項提議獲得OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）支持。
根據《路透》報導，Pachocki 周日（22日）在部落格文章中指出，AI開發商應就模型能力設定共同門檻，並承諾在業界對AI行為的理解與監控能力達到具體里程碑前，不讓模型跨越相關限制。
他認為，這些門檻除了依據困惑度，也應納入其他衡量指標。
Pachocki 將困惑度描述為衡量模型智慧程度的指標，評估模型平均預測下一個token的能力。token是資料的基本單位；困惑度愈低，代表模型的預測能力愈好。
Pachocki 指出，AI最快可能在2027年便協助推動AI訓練方法的根本性進展，進而使技術發展速度超越監控與安全機制的進步。
他表示，在新的監控與安全機制到位之前，開發商應承諾不跨越業界商定的模型能力門檻。
Pachocki 主張，業界應制定一套共同標準，明確規範AI開發的第一道限制，以及在突破該限制前必須達成哪些里程碑。
奧特曼支持這項提議，並在社群平台X發文表示，業界應尋求就AI發展的共同限制達成共識。他形容帕喬基的文章是「OpenAI一段時間以來發布過最重要的內容」，並指出這類限制有助於確保AI的安全與可控性。
paras_en: With AI models rapidly improving, OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has suggested that the industry establish shared limits on model development and use perplexity as a universal metric for measuring AI progress. The proposal has received backing from OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.

According to Reuters, Pachocki wrote in a blog post on Sunday (22nd) that AI developers should set common thresholds for model capability and agree not to exceed those limits until the industry reaches concrete milestones in understanding and monitoring AI behavior.
He believes that these thresholds should include perplexity as well as other metrics.

Pachocki describes perplexity as a measure of a model’s intelligence, evaluating how well it can predict the next token on average. A token is the basic unit of data; lower perplexity indicates better predictive ability.
Pachocki points out that AI could soon, possibly by 2027, drive fundamental advances in training methods, potentially outpacing progress in monitoring and safety mechanisms.
He states that until new monitoring and safety mechanisms are in place, developers should commit not to cross the industry-agreed capability thresholds.

Pachocki argues that the industry should create a set of common standards that clearly define the first restriction on AI development and specify the milestones that must be achieved before breaking that barrier.

Altman supports the proposal and posted on X that the industry should seek consensus on common restrictions for AI development. He called Pachocki’s article “the most important content OpenAI has released in a long time” and noted that such limits help ensure AI safety and controllability.

items.title: 簽約訂單重新報價！戴爾、惠普、聯想及美超微等AI伺服器廠要求最高漲價45%
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，戴爾、惠普企業(HPE)、聯想及美超微(Super Micro)等廠商正要求客戶為已簽訂的AI伺服器訂單支付更高價格，部分訂單漲幅達25%至45%。這些AI伺服器通常搭載輝達或超微GPU及記憶體晶片、網路設備等零組件，供應商給出的理由是記憶體成本飆升和電路板短缺。
漲價主要推手是記憶體。根據摩根大通研究，自2024年初以來，記憶體價格累計上漲超過400%；伺服器DRAM合約價光是今年第一季就上漲約90%。
HPE執行長Antonio Neri更指出，現今的記憶體價格已超過一台伺服器物料成本的一半。
受影響客戶包括全球知名量化交易機構Jane Street、Optiver和Hudson River Trading，這些機構正建造大型資料中心，為交易策略研究提供算力支援。
知情人士透露，搭載GPU的AI伺服器價格至少上漲20%至30%，而記憶體成本佔比較高的CPU，價格已漲至原來的三倍甚至更高。此外，全球電路板短缺料將持續到2028年。
報導也提及，相關漲價發生在合約簽署數月後，增加了金融交易機構等客戶的資料中心建置成本。量化交易公司XTX Markets因一筆價值5.49億美元的戴爾伺服器訂單發生價格爭議，已在愛爾蘭起訴戴爾。XTX表示，戴爾要求在原合約金額之外追加約6200萬至7000萬美元費用，戴爾則稱無法自行承擔零件成本上漲。

items.title: 南韓「救市」！或是2008年金融危機後首度啟動股市穩定基金
paras: 南韓股市遭遇沉重賣壓，政府決定提前部署救市措施。南韓副總理兼財政部長 Lee Hyoung-il 周日（22日）主持金融市場緊急會議後宣布，政府將立即啟動股市穩定基金的動用準備工作，並放寬上市公司庫藏股申報限制，同時加強打擊非法放空，試圖緩解市場賣壓。
這是2008年全球金融危機以來，南韓股市穩定基金第三度進入啟動準備階段，也是首次自2008年實際動用後，再度正式展開啟動準備。政府表示，將視市場情況決定是否動用基金。
相關措施將陸續實施：上市公司每日庫藏股申報量上限自11月24日起放寬，為期三個月；金融監督院（FSS）與南韓交易所也將同步展開為期三個月的非法放空專案監控。
南韓政府此次出手，主要是因為韓股20日重挫逾5%，同日美國那斯達克指數也下跌5.28%。官員認為，全球AI產業面臨政策風險升高、獲利與融資前景不確定、美國資料中心監管趨嚴，以及半導體出口管制加強等多重壓力，市場疑慮持續升溫。
此外，外資持續撤出、企業庫藏股買盤也有減弱跡象，進一步加重市場壓力，使南韓股市面臨愈來愈大的「賣出韓國」賣壓。

股市穩定基金重啟準備 2008年後首見

南韓股市穩定基金是政府用來填補股市流動性缺口的政策工具。2008年全球金融危機期間，南韓交易所等機構於當年10月籌設規模5,150億韓元的基金，並從11月起按月進場買股，持續至2009年3月。
此後，南韓政府曾在2020年及2022年兩度啟動基金準備程序，但最終都未實際進場。此次則是2008年以來，政府首次再次正式展開啟動準備工作。
政府表示，將立即檢視基金啟動機制，確保能依市場情勢迅速部署，並研究提升基金運作效率的配套措施。
不過，與會官員也強調，儘管近期市場波動加劇，AI產業中長期成長前景仍具合理性，投資人不應過度恐慌或跟風拋售。

放寬庫藏股限制 加強監控非法放空

除了準備動用穩定基金，南韓政府也將放寬企業庫藏股申報限制。自11月24日起，未來三個月內，上市公司每日申報買回自家股票的數量上限將予以調整。
原有規定限制企業每日申報買回量，不得超過預定回購總量的10%與過去一個月日均成交量25%兩者中的較大值，且不得超過公司總股本的1%。
此次放寬限制，目的是增加企業買回自家股票的操作空間，在市場下跌時提供更多買盤支撐。近期企業庫藏股一直是吸收外資賣壓的重要力量，但部分大型企業的回購計畫接近尾聲，市場開始擔心承接力道減弱。
在放空監管方面，金融監督院與南韓交易所將聯手展開為期三個月的強化監控，嚴格處置查獲的非法放空行為。
政府也將密切追蹤信用貸款、融資交易及強制平倉情況，避免連鎖賣壓擴大，並同步強化強制平倉預告等投資人保護措施。

外資持續撤出 韓股陷「賣出韓國」壓力

根據《路透》報導，南韓股市正面臨持續性的外資撤離潮，外資淨流出已延續數月，累計規模創LSEG資料紀錄新高。市場當前的主要問題，在於買盤持續萎縮，難以消化賣壓。
值得注意的是，三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 等AI晶片主要企業獲利屢創新高，也推出規模龐大的股東回報計畫，但股市表現與企業基本面卻持續背離。
分析人士指出，韓股目前面臨的壓力，更多來自買盤不足，而非企業基本面惡化。
Kiwoom證券分析師Han Jiyoung表示，市場基本上正經歷全面性的「賣出韓國」趨勢，當前挑戰在於尋找能夠吸引外資回流的催化因素。
在外資持續撤出、買盤支撐轉弱之際，南韓政府推出一系列穩定措施，試圖阻止市場賣壓進一步擴大。官員則重申，AI產業中長期基本面並未出現根本性變化，認為市場目前的恐慌情緒可能過度。

items.title: 川普：美股市值蒸發超過6兆美元　100%怪民主黨
items.title_en: Trump: US Stock Market Lost Over $6 Trillion, 100% Blames Democrats
paras: 美國總統川普周日(22日)把美股市值近來蒸發逾6兆美元，歸咎於民主黨在11月3日期中選舉後重掌國會，並安撫市場稱「國家很快就會重新強大起來」。
他在Truth Social發文說，「自民主黨那場相當奇怪的『勝利』以來，市場已下跌超過6兆美元，單是那斯達克就跌了20%」，並批評民主黨推行「反增長、只圖報復」的政策。

美股三大指數上周五(20日)集體重挫；道瓊大跌1.93%、連跌第五日收在48147.33點；標普500挫跌3.7%、連跌第七日創2020年以來最長連跌紀錄，收6910.39點；那斯達克指數跌5.28%，收22617.73點，吐光今年所有漲幅。以周線計，道指累跌8.02%、標普累跌8.61%、那指累跌10.02%、那指100累跌10.43%。晶片股更迎來2001年9月以來最差一周，輝達市值自今年10月6日高點以來蒸發約2.7兆美元。
但市場解讀股災並非單一因素造成。美國財長貝森特周日表示，拋售「是多種因素疊加」，早在民主黨民調領先時就已啟動，選後加速。投資者憂慮民主黨在「超級智能(SI)」建設上的立場會拖慢資料中心與AI擴張步伐，加上Fed接連放出鷹派言論，市場擔心政策過度收緊釀成失誤。川普上周五亦再度炮轟Fed利率過高、決策帶「政治屬性」。
知名科技分析師艾夫斯(Dan Ives)則把上周形容為科技股的「完美風暴」，民主黨壓倒性勝選可能帶來AI與資料中心監管政策緊縮，加上黃仁勳從輝達離職，雙重衝擊集中引爆。
paras_en: US President Donald Trump on Sunday (the 22nd) said the US stock market has recently evaporated more than $6 trillion in value, blaming the Democrats for regaining control of Congress after the November 3 midterm elections, and he tried to reassure the market that “the country will soon be strong again.”

He posted on Truth Social that “since the Democrats’ rather odd ‘victory,’ the market has dropped over $6 trillion, with the Nasdaq alone down 20%,” and criticized the Democrats for pursuing “anti‑growth, revenge‑focused” policies.

The three major US indexes all slumped on Friday (the 20th): the Dow fell 1.93% for the fifth consecutive day to 48,147.33 points; the S&P 500 dropped 3.7%, marking a seven‑day losing streak—the longest since 2020—and closed at 6,910.39; the Nasdaq fell 5.28% to 22,617.73, wiping out all gains made this year. On a weekly basis the Dow is down 8.02%, the S&P 8.61%, the Nasdaq 10.02% and the Nasdaq‑100 10.43%. Chip stocks suffered their worst week since September 2001, with Nvidia’s market cap shedding about $2.7 trillion since its October 6 peak this year.

But market analysts say the crash is not due to a single factor. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen said on Sunday that the sell‑off “is the result of multiple overlapping factors,” noting that selling began when Democrats were already leading in the polls and accelerated after the election. Investors worry that Democratic policies on “super‑intelligence (SI)” could slow data‑center and AI expansion, and hawkish Fed comments have raised fears of overly tight policy. Trump also lashed out again on Friday, calling Fed rates too high and accusing the Fed’s decisions of having a “political character.”

Well‑known tech analyst Dan Ives described last week as a “perfect storm” for tech stocks: an overwhelming Democratic win could tighten AI and data‑center regulation, and Nvidia’s co‑founder Jensen Huang’s departure adds a double blow that ignited the sell‑off.

items.title: 美股期指強彈那指漲近3%金銀同步回升　亞股開低韓股挫4%失守4700點
items.title_en: US Stock Index Futures Surge Nearly 3% as Gold and Silver Rise; Asian Markets Open Lower, Korean Shares Fall 4% to 4700 Points
paras: 美股三大股指期貨在亞股周一(23日)早盤交易階段齊步開高，截至台灣時間周一早上8時52分，那斯達克100期指上漲2.83%，標普500期指漲2.11%，道指期漲1.4%。現貨黃金日內漲逾1%，收復每盎司36000美元大關，現貨白銀上漲2%重返42美元大關。
今年7月中旬以來，美股三大股指期貨持續走跌，科技股與半導體股遭大幅拋售，地緣政治風險與AI投資回報疑慮成為主要拖累因素，那指期貨領跌且跌幅顯著大於道指期貨。
亞股方面，日本股市因國定假日休市一天，南韓綜合股指(KOSPI)周一開盤下跌2.77%，此後跌幅擴大至4%，跌破4700點，SK海力士下跌4%，三星電子下跌4.7%。台灣加權指數周一開盤下跌425.82點，跌幅1.18%，報35607.47點，富時中國A50指數期貨開價0.06%。
在美股持續回檔後，華爾街開始密集尋找「底部訊號」，市場情緒被形容為「非常脆弱」，但逢低買盤的苗頭已經出現。
美國財富管理與投資機構愛德華·瓊斯高級全球投資策略師Angelo Kourkafas指出，回撤大到一定程度總會吸引買家，但他更關注表面之下的動向，必需消費品等防禦類股近期表現突出，顯示避險氛圍濃厚。他也期待看到銀行、工業等對經濟敏感的族群轉強，作為情緒企穩的確認訊號。
Nationwide首席市場策略師Mark Hackett認為，這輪拋售已將估值重置至更具吸引力的水準，投資者情緒指標也跌到歷史上常視為買進訊號的區間，但短期內情緒化賣壓仍可能壓過機會主義買盤。
技術型態方面，投資管理機構State Street首席策略師Michael Arone正追蹤標普500成分股距52週高點的跌幅，以及個股同向波動程度，並指出相關指標已接近超賣但尚未極端。
Granite Wealth創辦人Bruce Zaro則指出，紐交所創新高與創新低個股數量對比的指標已發出觸底訊號，但高於50日均線的股票比例仍偏低，「我們正接近一個絕佳的逢低買入點」。
避險基金Cynosure Strategies負責人兼投資長Brian Smedley直言「市場向下已超調，就像今年稍早向上超調一樣」，認為拋售也許已接近尾聲，投資者終將重拾對AI需求的信心。
不過，高盛交易部門警告，投資人整體倉位仍偏高，市場尚未出現足以催生強勢反彈的大規模恐慌性拋盤。
paras_en: US stock index futures rose in tandem during the early Asian trading session on Monday (23rd), with the Nasdaq 100 futures up 2.83%, the S&P 500 futures up 2.11%, and the Dow futures up 1.4% as of 8:52 a.m. Taiwan time; spot gold gained over 1% intraday, reclaiming the $3,600 per ounce mark, while spot silver rose 2% to return to the $42 per ounce level.

Since mid-July, US stock index futures have continued to decline, with technology and semiconductor stocks heavily sold off; geopolitical risk and doubts over AI investment returns have become the main drag, causing the Nasdaq futures to lead the decline and fall significantly more than the Dow futures.

In Asia, Japan's market was closed for a national holiday, and South Korea's KOSPI fell 2.77% at the open, then widened to a 4% drop, breaking below 4,700 points; SK Hynix fell 4% and Samsung Electronics fell 4.7%. Taiwan's weighted index fell 425.82 points, a 1.18% decline, to 35,607.47, and the FTSE China A50 futures opened at 0.06%.
After the US continued to retreat, Wall Street began searching intensively for a “bottom signal,” with market sentiment described as “very fragile,” yet signs of buying at lows have already emerged.

Angelo Kourkafas, senior global investment strategist at Edward Jones Wealth Management and Investment, noted that a pullback of a certain magnitude will inevitably attract buyers, but he is more concerned with underlying trends; defensive consumer staples have recently performed strongly, indicating a robust hedging atmosphere. He also expects to see banks and industry, which are sensitive to the economy, strengthen as confirmation of stabilizing sentiment.

Mark Hackett, chief market strategist at Nationwide, believes this round of selling has reset valuations to a more attractive level, and investor sentiment indicators have fallen into a range historically viewed as a buying signal, but short‑term emotional selling pressure may still outweigh opportunistic buying.

From a technical perspective, Michael Arone, chief strategist at State Street, is tracking the decline of S&P 500 components from their 52‑week highs and the degree of co‑movement among individual stocks, noting that related indicators are approaching oversold but not yet extreme.

Bruce Zaro, founder of Granite Wealth, pointed out that the ratio of new highs to new lows on the NYSE has issued a bottom signal, yet the proportion of stocks above the 50‑day moving average remains low, stating, “We are approaching an excellent low‑buy point.”

Brian Smedley, head of Cynosure Strategies and chief investment officer, bluntly said, “The market has overreacted downwards, just as it overreacted upwards earlier this year,” suggesting that the selling may be nearing its end and investors will eventually regain confidence in AI demand.

However, Goldman Sachs' trading division cautioned that overall investor positions remain high, and the market has yet to experience the large‑scale panic selling necessary to trigger a strong rebound.

items.title: 監控恐趕不上模型進化！OpenAI疾呼同業設共同門檻：AI最快可能在2027年加速自我發展
paras: OpenAI首席科學家Jakub Pachocki周日(22日)發文呼籲全球AI企業建立行業統一標準，在研究人員具備更可靠的模型行為理解與監控能力之前，各家公司應承諾不突破約定的開發門檻。OpenAI執行長奧特曼公開表態支持，稱這是「OpenAI一段時間以來發表的最重要內容之一」。
Pachocki建議以「困惑度」（Perplexity）作為可跨企業追蹤的參考指標，該指標衡量模型預測下一段文本的能力，數值越低代表預測越強。
他公布OpenAI內部數據：GPT-3.5的對數困惑度約0.99，GPT-4約0.91；當指標降至0.8以下時，模型在網絡安全與數學領域浮現新能力；跌至約0.76時，已能在部分開放數學難題上取得突破。
Pachocki預估，一旦進入0.68至0.7區間，模型可能出現更多「變革性能力」，但目前無法確定具體形態。
最令Pachocki警惕的是時間差。Pachocki警告，AI最早可能在2027年推動預訓練技術出現一輪飛躍，速度可能超過研究人員在對齊與行為監控上的進展。「我們理解和監控AI行為的能力，未必追得上模型自我進化的節奏。」
因此，Pachocki提議AI業界應共同建立模型評測、透明度與安全紅隊測試標準，在模型首次投入使用前完成評估，並開發比現有思維鏈監控工具更先進的監測機制後，才允許突破下一道門檻。
但他也坦承困惑度並非完美指標：各企業訓練數據與評測集不同，數值難以直接橫向比較；該指標也無法涵蓋思維鏈推理等預訓練之外的技術進步，跨企業通用評測標準仍存技術難題。
奧特曼則在X平台上回應說：「若能就共同限制達成一致，將有助於確保安全與控制。」
與此同時，美國監管討論同步升溫。民主黨議員正醞釀下屆國會AI監管方案，科羅拉多州參議員John Hickenlooper提議設立參議院AI特別委員會，馬里蘭州參議員Chris Van Hollen表態支持；民主黨打算2027年1月取得國會多數後，將AI列為優先議題，涵蓋資料中心監管、安全標準、第三方評估等，但川普政府一貫反對限制AI開發施，白宮與國會監管路線分歧，料將成為下一輪政策博弈焦點。

items.title: 黃仁勳回鍋輝達現轉機？貝森特「改口」、仍追查中國業務出口管制疑雲
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）對黃仁勳重返輝達(NVDA-US) 執掌公司的可能性，態度似乎出現轉變。相較於先前主張輝達應大幅改組、由外部人士接任領導職務，貝森特最新談話並未排除黃仁勳回歸，為這位共同創辦人重新掌舵留下空間。
貝森特周日（22日）接受《CBS》節目 Face the Nation 訪問時表示，政府必須先釐清輝達相關違規行為的責任歸屬。他說：「我認為我們必須看看責任最終落在哪裡，以及公司底層有哪些從事惡意違規行為的人。」
他也透露，截至22日，美國財政部仍未收到輝達針對是否設立空殼公司規避出口管制的正式答覆，而政府要求的回覆期限為11月25日。
貝森特這次的說法，與他上周在《福斯新聞》節目中呼籲輝達進行「大幅整頓」，並主張下一任領導人應從公司外部尋找的強硬立場有所不同。
市場也開始反映黃仁勳回歸的可能性。預測市場平台Polymarket顯示，黃仁勳重新出任輝達執行長的機率，已從11月21日的11%升至14%。
貝森特上周曾公開要求輝達進行大幅改組，並表示這家AI晶片大廠的下一任領導人應由公司外部人士出任，當時被解讀為美國財政部不支持黃仁勳回鍋。
但在22日接受《CBS》訪問時，當主持人再次追問輝達是否應尋找外部人選領導公司，貝森特回答：「我說過他們（輝達）應該從外部找人，但他（黃仁勳）現在就在外部了。」
不過，貝森特強調，政府仍須釐清違規行為的責任層級，包括問題究竟出在基層、中階管理層，還是一路延伸至公司最高層。他也表示，有信心輝達各委員會能迅速完成調查，並提出可靠的結果。

川普支持黃仁勳回歸 董事會態度不同

黃仁勳是否重返輝達，也牽涉白宮與公司董事會之間的立場差異。
美國總統川普公開支持黃仁勳回歸，並呼籲輝達董事會讓這位30多年前的共同創辦人重新出任原職。黃仁勳的支持者也持續敦促董事會重新考慮相關決定。
然而，輝達董事會已明確表態，無意讓黃仁勳回歸，與川普的立場形成對照。
分析認為，如果董事會堅持不讓黃仁勳復職，向政府提交的調查答覆可能更傾向將責任歸於前任執行長；反之，若政府接受黃仁勳回歸，部分監管壓力可能因此降低。
貝森特最新談話讓這兩種可能性都尚未排除，但輝達對中國業務是否涉及違反出口管制的疑慮，仍有待釐清。
貝森特上周要求輝達在11月25日前向川普政府說明，公司是否曾設立空殼公司以規避出口管制。他22日再次確認，財政部目前尚未收到輝達的答覆。

items.title: 強力護盤！中國三大穩市新政齊發 釋出近4000億融資空間  A股能止跌嗎?
items.title_en: Strong Market Support! China’s Three Major Stabilization Policies Released, Unleashing Nearly 400 Billion in Financing Space – Can A‑Shares Stop Falling?
paras: 中國監管高層周日(22日)針對近期A股持續震盪，一次性推出三大穩市「新政」，涵蓋調整融資保證金比例、推進創業板做市商制度、實施一攬子降費三項內容，旨在穩市場、穩預期，強化穩市力量。
經中國證監會批准，滬深北交易所發布《關於調整融資保證金比例等相關安排的通知》，將融資保證金比例下限從100%調降至80%，自2026年11月30日起實施。
根據一位券商非銀首席分析師測算，新規明確存量融資合約可適用80%重算保證金可用餘額，並非新老划斷，同等保證金最多可融規模抬升25%，全市場理論可釋放約 4000億元​ 融資空間。
舉例而言，保證金比例為100%時，投資者以100萬元保證金最多融資100萬元(人民幣，下同)，槓桿1倍；降至80%後，同樣100萬元保證金可融資125萬元，槓桿升至1.25倍，可融買入規模提升25%。
值得注意的是，本次調整是今年1月剛從80%上調至100%後再度調回，屬於同一套逆周期工具箱的來回切換。今年初上調有效抑制了市場過熱，而2023年8月下調則明顯提振了融資餘額與交易活躍度，穩市信號明確。
根據Wind統計數據顯示，截至上周四(19日)，A股融資融券餘額為2兆2222.85億元，創近一年新低；其中融資餘額2兆1927.43億元，融券餘額295.42億元。兩融餘額已從6月末的3兆元回落至2.2兆元，市場去槓桿相對充分。
分析師認為，降低保證金比例雖不影響存量維保比例，但為看好後市的投資者提供更多加倉機會，有助增量資金入市，並對券商的兩融利息收入與經紀業務形成邊際催化。
同一天，深交所就《創業板股票做市交易業務細則》公開徵求意見。業內人士指出，這是深化投資端改革、壯大穩市力量、增強市場韌性的重要機制安排。
創業板科技創新公司相對集中，受技術迭代、行業景氣、市場情緒及海外波動影響，股價波動較大。做市商憑藉專業定價與風險管理能力，在市場波動時提供逆向報價，充當「緩衝墊」。
多家券商研究顯示，做市股票的日内振幅與波動率通常低於未做市股票，有助減少價格跳空。此外，做市商持續報價還能將企業基本面更充分反映到股價中，收窄買賣價差，降低投資者交易成本。
滬深兩大交易所同步推出降費措施；上交所免收交易單元使用費、減免數據中心服務費，新增措施預計讓利13.68億元，今年度整體降費超24億元；深交所免收交易單元使用費、網絡投票服務費等，新增讓利 13.9億元，今年度整體降費超22億元。兩所並將年初已發布的免收上市費、債券交易經手費等措施有效期延長兩年至2028年。分析認為，降費有助提升機構交易活力與市場機構化進程。
對於後市，東方财富證券首席策略官陳果指出，滬深300等主要寬基指數的風險溢價(ERP)已高於歷史均值一倍標準差，A股下行風險有限，相對於債券的風險收益比較高。「恐慌並不比亢奮更理性」，當下正是挖掘價值的良機。
華創證券的姚佩表示，A股本益比中位數已由31倍降至19.3倍，接近2024年「924行情」啟動前的18.4倍，獲利預期並未顯著下修，優質資產配置性價比顯現。
中信建投夏凡捷認為，美股大跌後有望迎來空頭回補，A股同樣超跌，短期或現技術性反彈，出現類似2024年初「V型底」的可能性較大；一旦微觀流動性改善，暴跌的小微盤與主題熱點有望快速修復。
paras_en: On Sunday (22nd), Chinese regulatory authorities introduced three new market-stabilizing policies in a single move to address the recent volatility in A‑shares, covering adjustments to margin requirements, the implementation of a market-making system for the STAR Market, and a bundle of fee reductions, all aimed at stabilizing the market and expectations while strengthening market support.

Approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges issued a notice on adjusting margin requirements, lowering the minimum margin ratio from 100% to 80% effective from November 30, 2026.

According to a chief analyst at a brokerage’s non‑bank division, the new rule allows existing margin contracts to be recalculated at 80% of the available margin balance, without distinguishing new from old contracts; the same margin can lift borrowing capacity by up to 25%, theoretically freeing about 400 billion yuan of margin space across the market.

For example, with a 100% margin ratio, an investor can borrow up to 1 million yuan with 1 million yuan of margin (leverage 1×); at 80%, the same 1 million yuan of margin can borrow 1.25 million yuan, raising leverage to 1.25× and increasing borrowing volume by 25%.

It is noteworthy that this adjustment reverses the January increase from 80% to 100% and then back again, part of the same counter‑cyclical toolkit; the January hike curbed overheating, while the August cut visibly boosted margin balances and trading activity, sending a clear stabilization signal.

Wind data shows that as of last Thursday (19th), A‑share margin and short‑sale balances stood at 2.222285 trillion yuan, a near‑one‑year low; margin alone was 2.192743 trillion yuan and short‑sale 29.542 billion yuan, down from 3 trillion yuan at the end of June, indicating a substantial deleveraging.

Analysts believe that lowering the margin ratio, while not affecting existing maintenance ratios, offers bullish investors more opportunities to add positions, attracting incremental capital and marginally boosting brokerage interest income and brokerage business.

On the same day, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange solicited comments on the “Detailed Rules for Market‑Making Trading on the STAR Market”; industry insiders view it as a key mechanism to deepen investment‑side reform, strengthen market‑support forces, and enhance market resilience.

STAR Market tech‑innovation companies are relatively concentrated and subject to technology cycles, industry cycles, market sentiment, and overseas volatility, leading to higher price swings; market makers, with professional pricing and risk management, provide counter‑quotes during volatility, acting as a “buffer cushion.”

Research from several brokerages shows that the intraday amplitude and volatility of market‑made stocks are typically lower than non‑market‑made stocks, helping to reduce price gaps. Continuous quoting by market makers also better reflects fundamentals in prices, narrowing bid‑ask spreads and lowering trading costs for investors.

Both Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges launched fee cuts simultaneously; the Shanghai Stock Exchange waived trading unit usage fees and reduced data center service fees, with new measures expected to save 1.368 billion yuan, bringing total fee cuts this year to over 2.4 billion yuan. The Shenzhen Stock Exchange waived trading unit usage fees, network voting service fees, etc., with new savings of 1.39 billion yuan, bringing total fee cuts this year to over 2.2 billion yuan. Both exchanges also extended the effective period of previously announced fee waivers for listing and bond trading to 2028. Analysts say fee cuts will boost institutional trading activity and market institutionalization.

Regarding the future, Chen Guo, Chief Strategy Officer at Oriental Fortune Securities, noted that the risk premium (ERP) of major broad indices like the Shanghai‑Shenzhen 300 is already more than one standard deviation above the historical mean, indicating limited downside risk for A‑shares. Compared to bonds, the risk‑return profile is relatively higher. “Panic is not more rational than excitement,” he said, calling the current moment a good opportunity to uncover value.

Yao Pei of Huachuang Securities said the median P/E of A‑shares has fallen from 31× to 19.3×, close to the 18.4× level before the 2024 “924” rally, and earnings expectations have not been significantly cut, highlighting the value‑to‑cost ratio of quality assets.

Xia Fanjie of CITIC JianTou believes that after the sharp decline in U.S. stocks, a short‑covering rebound is likely, and A‑shares are similarly oversold. A short‑term technical rebound is possible, similar to the V‑shaped bottom at the start of 2024; once micro‑liquidity improves, the small‑cap and thematic stocks that fell sharply may recover quickly.

隨後密西根大學調查美國11月消費者信心指數終值為負51.5符合預期，但消費者一年與五年通貨膨脹預期終值分別降至3.7%及3.3%，並據FED理事庫克稱當前利率不足以遏制通貨膨脹，支持再升息，但美國公債收益率下跌削弱美元吸引力，拖累美元兌日圓跌至158.40低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於159.00-20，支撐於157.70-90。
◆EUR/USD
上周澳洲令人震驚的疲軟就業報告引發經濟恐急劇下滑的擔憂，市場押注澳洲利率已在4.85%見頂，而頑固的通貨膨脹意味著利率不會迅速下調，市場完全消化澳洲央行(RBA)明年8月首次降息的預期，而且AI前景憂慮重創全球股市及大宗商品價格走低，上週五衝擊澳幣與紐元分別跌至十一個月及六年低點，拖累歐元兌美元觸及1.0956低點。

◆GBP/USD

上週五市場研究機構GfK調查英國11月消費者信心指數升至負22符合預期，並據英國公布10月零售銷售意外較前月增長0.7%，而且英國10月公共部門淨借款額為170億英鎊低於預估值，同時下修26/27財政年4月至9月期間借款36億英鎊，推升英鎊兌美元至1.3130高點，但也門胡塞武裝警告紅海沿岸民眾撤離，地緣政治風險打壓英鎊兌美元回落至1.3072低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3060-80，阻力於1.3150-70。

items.title: 波斯灣戰火升溫！川普再威脅伊朗：新年後不達協議就空襲
items.title_en: Tensions Rise in the Persian Gulf! Trump Threatens Iran Again: Airstrikes If No Agreement After New Year
paras: 美國總統川普週日(22日)接受《福斯新聞》獨家專訪時再度對伊朗發出軍事威脅稱，若美伊無法達成協議，他傾向於新年後下令發動新一輪軍事打擊。他同時痛批正在進行的外交談判，指責伊朗談判代表故意拖延時間，並在美國期中選舉後加劇敵對行動。
川普表示，他們現在比選舉前更咄咄逼人，並將伊朗談判代表稱為「職業踢踏舞演員」，嘲諷「他們整天都在談，除了談還是談，但全是廢話」。
目前美國仍對伊朗港口實施海上封鎖，荷姆茲海峽周邊軍事對抗持續，川普預期美伊軍隊之間仍可能發生相互報復性打擊。他甚至公開表示，希望伊朗嘗試突破封鎖，「他們最終都會沉到海底，就像他們其他海軍艦艇一樣」。
與此同時，伊朗多座城市再現反政府示威。川普也直接向伊朗抗議者喊話：「繼續抗議。」
此前幾日，川普曾稱不急於決定重新採取軍事行動，並多次指出1月1日之後是美國應對衝突的潛在轉折點。
另據《CNBC》報導，川普發言之際，波斯灣地區軍事摩擦正快速升級，沙烏地阿拉伯與巴林上週末均稱遭伊朗相關武裝力量攻擊。
由沙國領導、打擊胡塞武裝的「支持葉門合法政府聯盟」週日在X上發文：「防空系統攔截並摧毀一架飛向利雅德地區的無人機，週六晚間還攔截一枚飛向沙國西部重要能源煉油與出口設施的彈道飛彈。」
巴林也報告遭襲。巴林內政部也在X上表示，一處民用工業設施遭伊朗襲擊起火，造成兩人受傷，分別是一名巴林公民和一名巴基斯坦籍居民。巴林是美國海軍第五艦隊駐地。
伊朗國家媒體上週六(21日)晚間報導指出，該國革命衛隊向美國駐巴林軍事設施發射飛彈和無人機，還稱防空系統攔截一架美軍MQ-9無人機；美國中央司令部尚未回應置評請求。
英國海事貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)也通報指出，上週六阿曼附近有兩艘油輪遭不明飛行物襲擊。

paras_en: On Sunday (22nd), U.S. President Donald Trump, in an exclusive interview with Fox News, once again issued a military threat to Iran, saying that if the U.S. and Iran cannot reach an agreement, he would be inclined to order a new round of military strikes after the New Year. He also blasted the ongoing diplomatic talks, accusing Iran’s negotiating representatives of deliberately delaying time and escalating hostility after the U.S. midterm elections.

Trump said that they are now more aggressive than before the election, and called Iran’s negotiating representatives “professional tap dancers,” mocking that “they talk all day, they talk, they talk, but it’s all nonsense.”

The United States still imposes a maritime blockade on Iranian ports, and military confrontations around the Strait of Hormuz continue. Trump expects that there may still be retaliatory strikes between U.S. and Iranian forces. He even publicly stated that he hopes Iran will try to break the blockade, saying, “They will eventually sink to the bottom of the sea, just like their other naval vessels.”
Meanwhile, anti-government protests have reappeared in several Iranian cities. Trump also directly shouted at Iranian protesters, “Keep protesting.”

In the days before, Trump said he was not in a hurry to decide on re‑taking military action, and repeatedly pointed out that after January 1st is a potential turning point for the U.S. response to the conflict.

According to CNBC, as Trump spoke, military friction in the Persian Gulf was rapidly escalating, and Saudi Arabia and Bahrain both claimed they had been attacked by Iranian‑affiliated armed forces over the weekend.

The Saudi-led “Support the Legitimate Government of Yemen” coalition posted on X on Sunday: “The air defense system intercepted and destroyed a drone heading toward the Riyadh area, and on Saturday night it also intercepted a ballistic missile heading toward a major energy refinery and export facility in western Saudi Arabia.”

Bahrain also reported an attack. Bahrain’s Ministry of Interior posted on X that a civilian industrial facility was attacked by Iran, caught fire, and injured two people—a Bahraini citizen and a Pakistani resident. Bahrain hosts the U.S. Navy’s Fifth Fleet.

Iranian state media reported on Saturday night (21st) that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps fired missiles and drones at U.S. military facilities in Bahrain, and claimed that the air defense system intercepted an American MQ‑9 drone; the U.S. Central Command has not yet responded to a request for comment.
The UK Maritime Trade Operations office (UKMTO) also reported that two oil tankers near Oman were attacked by unidentified flying objects on Saturday.

However, military tensions did not stop international oil prices from falling. Traders believe that Middle Eastern oil supply remains ample, and U.S. crude inventories continue to rise, causing oil prices to fall for three consecutive weeks.

Currently, the U.S. and Iran still have clear differences over maritime blockades, passage through the Strait of Hormuz, and final agreement terms. As Gulf states continue to face attacks, military confrontation and diplomatic negotiations run in parallel, leaving Middle Eastern energy supply and regional security shrouded in uncertainty.

paras: 美元指數週五 (20 日) 小幅走低，終止連八個交易日上漲。市場對人工智慧 (AI) 產業的疑慮持續衝擊全球股市，資金轉進美國公債避險，帶動殖利率下滑，推升日元與瑞郎。不過，聯準會 (Fed) 官員持續釋出鷹派訊號，加上市場降低對風險貨幣的持有意願，限制美元跌幅。
美股尾盤時段，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣表現的美元指數下跌 0.07%，至 103.87，仍接近前一交易日觸及、2025 年 4 月以來的最高水準。
美元這波漲勢在 11 月 10 日加速，當時美國通膨數據高於預期，強化市場對聯準會進一步緊縮政策的押注。聯準會理事沃勒 (Christopher Waller) 也表示，應考慮在 12 月升息 2 碼。
Bannockburn Capital Markets 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示：「我認為美元的上漲動能已經停滯……但現在就認定美元已經見頂，還有點太早。」
美債避險買盤湧現 日元、瑞郎受惠
AI 相關疑慮持續壓抑全球股市，Anthropic (ANT-US) 週四創紀錄的上市案，也未能有效提振投資人信心。資金週五轉向公債避險，推動美債殖利率下滑，提高日元與瑞郎等低利率貨幣的相對吸引力。
Chandler 表示：「當美國利率下降時，低收益貨幣就顯得更具吸引力。」
美元兌瑞郎下跌 0.51%，報 1 美元可兌換 0.8396 瑞郎；美元兌日元下跌 0.73%，報 1 美元可兌換 158.50 日元，顯示瑞郎與日元雙雙兌美元升值。日元匯價仍接近日本當局今年 7 月進場干預、支撐日元時的水準。
除了美債殖利率下降，日本通膨數據也提供日元支撐。日本 10 月核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 年增率加速至 2.2%，連續第二個月高於日本銀行的 2% 目標，顯示物價壓力擴散，強化日銀近期升息的理由。
Chandler 指出：「日元今天走強，受到美國利率下降，以及日本 10 月 CPI 表現強勁的帶動。」
凱投宏觀分析師認為，日元近期的疲弱走勢不太可能持續。
隨著日本長期通膨預期已接近目標，殖利率進一步上升將主要反映實質利率提高，加上該機構預期美債殖利率將下降，兩項因素應有利日元。
聯準會維持鷹派 川普再批利率過高
儘管美元回落，策略師認為，聯準會偏向升息的政策前景仍將提供支撐。
ING 全球市場主管 Chris Turner 表示，雖然目前支持股市再度大幅修正的理由有限，但「聯準會沒有理由在短期內放棄鷹派論調」。
他指出，下週公布的美國個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE)，可能進一步確認聯準會有必要採取行動。
聯準會理事庫克 (Lisa Cook) 週五也支持進一步升息，表示目前政策利率不足以因應通膨，並稱她對通膨水準「深感憂慮」。
美國總統川普則在週五記者會上表示，目前利率過高，並批評聯準會具有「政治性」。
其他主要貨幣方面，歐元兌美元小跌至 1.0963 美元；英鎊兌美元下跌至 1.3080 美元，仍徘徊在一年低點附近。澳元與紐元分別下跌 0.71% 及 0.36%，反映風險貨幣持續承壓。
加密貨幣也遭拋售浪潮襲擊。
隨著投資人擔憂 AI 相關資產估值過高，賣壓擴及其他風險資產，比特幣週五跌破 6 萬美元，為 7 月以來首見，報導更新時下跌約 6%，至 57,939 美元。

paras_en: The U.S. dollar index slipped slightly on Friday (the 20th), ending an eight‑day winning streak. Ongoing concerns about the artificial‑intelligence (AI) sector continued to weigh on global equities, prompting a shift into U.S. Treasury safe‑haven assets, which pushed yields lower and boosted the yen and Swiss franc. However, hawkish signals from Federal Reserve officials and reduced appetite for risk currencies limited the dollar's decline.

In the late‑session of U.S. equities, the dollar index, which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.07% to 103.87, still near the highest level reached on the previous trading day, the peak since April 2025.

The dollar's recent rally accelerated on November 10 when U.S. inflation data came in hotter than expected, strengthening market bets on further Fed tightening. Fed Governor Christopher Waller also said a 25‑basis‑point rate hike in December should be considered.
Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets, said: “I think the dollar’s upward momentum has stalled… but it’s still a bit early to declare that the dollar has peaked.”
U.S. Treasury safe‑haven buying lifts yen and franc

AI‑related worries kept global equities under pressure, and even Anthropic’s (ANT‑US) record‑setting IPO on Thursday failed to lift investor confidence. On Friday, funds moved into Treasury safe‑haven assets, driving U.S. bond yields lower and raising the relative appeal of low‑yield currencies such as the yen and Swiss franc.
Chandler added: “When U.S. rates fall, low‑yield currencies become more attractive.”

The dollar fell 0.51% against the franc to $1 = 0.8396 CHF, and 0.73% against the yen to $1 = 158.50 JPY, indicating that both currencies appreciated versus the greenback. The yen rate remains close to the level at which Japanese authorities intervened in July to support the currency.

In addition to falling U.S. yields, Japanese inflation data also supported the yen. Japan’s October core consumer‑price index (CPI) annualised rate accelerated to 2.2%, the second consecutive month above the Bank of Japan’s 2% target, showing broader price pressure and bolstering the case for a recent BOJ rate hike.
Chandler noted: “The yen’s strength today is driven by falling U.S. rates and the strong October CPI reading in Japan.”
Macro analyst at KGI believes the yen’s recent weakness is unlikely to persist.

With Japan’s long‑term inflation expectations now near target, any further rise in yields will mainly reflect higher real rates, and the institution expects U.S. Treasury yields to fall – two factors that should benefit the yen.
Fed Maintains Hawkish Stance as Trump Again Criticises High Rates
Even though the dollar retreated, strategists say the Fed’s bias toward rate hikes will continue to provide support.

Chris Turner, head of global markets at ING, said that while there are limited reasons at present to justify another sharp equity correction, “the Fed has no reason to abandon its hawkish tone in the short term.”
He added that next week’s U.S. personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index could further confirm the Fed’s need to act.
Fed Governor Lisa Cook also backed further tightening on Friday, saying current policy rates are insufficient to curb inflation and expressing “deep concern” about inflation levels.
Former President Donald Trump told reporters on Friday that rates are currently too high and criticized the Fed as being “political.”

Among other major currencies, the euro slipped to $1.0963, the pound fell to $1.3080, hovering near a one‑year low, while the Australian and New Zealand dollars dropped 0.71% and 0.36% respectively, reflecting continued pressure on risk assets.
Cryptocurrencies also came under selling pressure.

As investors worried that AI‑related assets were overvalued, selling spread to other risk assets and Bitcoin fell below $60,000 on Friday – the first time since July – dropping about 6% to $57,939 at the time of the update.

The euro slipped 0.04% to $1.0963 per euro.
The pound fell 0.06% to $1.3080 per pound.
The Australian dollar dropped 0.71% to $0.6612 per Aussie.
The New Zealand dollar fell 0.36% to $0.5464 per kiwi.
The dollar weakened 0.73% to ¥158.50 per dollar.
The dollar weakened 0.51% to CHF 0.8396 per dollar.
The dollar rose 0.03% to C$1.4344 per dollar.

paras: 台股加權指數今(20)日再度破底，市場出現強烈的去槓桿壓力，單日跌點達2393點，創史上第三大跌點，一周來已跌掉7641點，周跌幅17.5%，台北匯市見到中央銀行全力穩盤調節，新台幣終場收在32.936元，升值0.6分，與股市脫鉤，台北外匯經紀公司成交值則縮至21.02億美元。
新台幣今日以32.96元、貶值1.8分開出後，盤中一度轉升值，午盤過後又見貶值壓力湧出，收盤半小時又轉升，顯示來回拋補的拉鋸力道激烈，但成交量萎縮，全日高低價差1.2角。
觀察主要亞幣，日元強彈超過0.4%，人民幣升0.3%，星元升0.15%上下，泰銖升約0.1%，新台幣收升0.02%，而韓元貶值約0.1%。
法人分析，聯準會官員有提到AI的蓬勃發展正在加劇經濟過熱風險，企業投資達到空前規模但經濟產能未必承受得住，使聯準會將不得不應對短期影響，而這些影響目前看來是推升通膨，在此鷹派聲浪下，暫難見到帶動外資回頭的訊號，使匯市偏弱整理。
paras_en: The Taiwan weighted index broke its low again today (20th), with the market under strong deleveraging pressure. It fell 2,393 points in a single day, the third‑largest point drop in history, and has lost 7,641 points over the past week, a weekly decline of 17.5%. In the Taipei foreign‑exchange market the central bank stepped in forcefully to stabilize the currency; the New Taiwan dollar closed at 32.936, appreciating 0.6 points and decoupling from the equity market. Turnover at Taipei FX brokers shrank to US$2.102 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.96, down 1.8 points, then rose briefly during the session. After the midday break, depreciation pressure resurfaced, but in the half‑hour before close it turned upward again, showing a fierce tug‑of‑war between buying and selling. However, trading volume contracted and the daily high‑low range was only 0.12 yuan.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen surged more than 0.4%, the Chinese renminbi rose 0.3%, the Singapore dollar gained about 0.15%, the Thai baht edged up roughly 0.1%, the New Taiwan dollar finished up 0.02%, while the South Korean won depreciated about 0.1%.

Analysts note that Federal Reserve officials have warned that the rapid growth of AI is heightening the risk of an overheated economy. Corporate investment is reaching unprecedented levels, but productive capacity may not keep pace, forcing the Fed to address short‑term impacts that currently appear to be feeding inflation. Amid this hawkish sentiment, there is little sign of foreign capital returning, leaving the FX market in a weak, consolidating stance.

Fed governors Waller and Bahl made hawkish remarks, and IMF chief Georgieva said on Thursday that energy supply shocks and AI demand are pushing global inflation up to 4.7%, prompting many economies to tighten policy and reinforcing the Fed’s rate‑hike bias, which has lifted the dollar to a 19‑month high. In Japan, September core machinery orders rose 13.4% year‑on‑year, missing expectations but falling 0.3% month‑on‑month, better than forecast. Reuters surveys show most economists expect the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to announce its third rate hike of the year in December and another hike before the end of March 2025. BOJ Governor Ueda told parliament that inflation may be easing gradually, but steady nominal wage growth and higher household income support consumption, which is expected to resume a modest upward trend, hinting at a near‑term hike that could support the yen, keeping USD/JPY around the low of 159.26.

Subsequent US data showed initial jobless claims ticked up to 203,000 and the Philadelphia Fed’s November manufacturing index fell to +6.3. The ISM leading‑index for October slipped 0.3% versus expectations. Markets continue betting on further Fed hikes while safe‑haven flows receded, pushing USD/JPY to a high of 159.96. The dollar‑yen pair is expected to face resistance at 159.60‑80 and support at 158.70‑90 today.
EUR/USD

Yesterday the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) governor, Brett, said inflation remains above target and the economic recovery is uneven. Australia’s Bureau of Statistics reported that October employment fell by 43,500 for the second consecutive month and the unemployment rate rose to a five‑year high of 4.9%. The weak data bolsters the view that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) may have peaked on rates and could cut later, with the rate‑swap market now pricing out any further RBA hikes and expecting cuts in the second half of next year. This pressure drags the Australian and New Zealand dollars lower and keeps EUR/USD flat around the low of 1.0954.

With French central bank (Banque de France) governor Villeroy noting that rising oil prices continue to fuel price pressures, the European Central Bank must stay vigilant. ECB data show the euro‑area’s September current‑account surplus modestly widened to €12.5 billion, and the Bundesbank’s monthly report highlighted that strong export demand and fiscal stimulus have led to unexpectedly robust German growth, which could pick up again in Q4 and push inflation higher, lifting EUR/USD to a high of 1.1010. Resistance today is seen at 1.0975‑95 with support at 1.0890‑1.0910.
GBP/USD

Bank of England forecasts indicate that UK inflation may stay above 2% for the longest stretch since the early 1990s, eroding confidence that the BOE can bring price gains back to target and keep them near that level. The Iran‑related war has driven energy prices up, likely pushing UK inflation to near 5% by mid‑next year and dragging the pound from its recent high of 1.3174 against the dollar. Later, the CBI reported that November industrial order balance fell to –12, and markets are watching how Prime Minister Sunak’s summit with the EU on Friday might affect the post‑Brexit situation, pressuring the pound down to a low of 1.3091. items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元漲勢暫歇 Anthropic上市提振風險偏好 日元走貶
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Gains Pause as Anthropic IPO Boosts Risk Appetite, Yen Depreciates
paras: 美元週四(19日)兌多數主要貨幣回落，近期漲勢暫歇。人工智慧(AI)公司Anthropic即將掛牌，提振市場風險偏好，削弱美元買盤。不過，聯準會(Fed)官員的鷹派談話與最新會議紀錄，仍使進一步升息的預期支撐美元，美元指數維持在約19個月高點附近。
美股尾盤時段，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報103.65；歐元兌美元上漲0.2%，報1.1002美元。
美元指數本週觸及2025年4月2日以來最高水準。當時，美國總統川普宣布大規模關稅措施，引發美國資產賣壓。
美元這波漲勢始於11月10日，當時美國通膨數據高於預期，促使投資人提高對聯準會緊縮政策的押注。聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)呼籲採取更積極措施對抗通膨，而10月27日至28日的會議紀錄也顯示，決策官員愈來愈擔心，可能需要進一步緊縮政策。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師奧斯本(Shaun Osborne)表示：「美元這段時間已經漲了不少，我認為目前匯價已反映許多利多。」
他指出，美元多頭若要在短期內推升匯價，需要更強的信心或更多利多消息。他並將美元部分回落，歸因於Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)前，市場風險情緒改善。
Anthropic的IPO定價高於原先行銷區間，帶動週四那斯達克期貨上漲，也提高市場對其上市表現的期待，重新提振AI類股投資情緒。
巴克萊分析師則認為，財政刺激與強勁的AI相關資本支出，反映美國經濟具有韌性，也意味經濟產出高於潛在水準的幅度可能擴大，利率將在更長時間內維持高檔，這些因素均有利美元。
儘管近期科技股遭到拋售，美元仍獲得資金流入支撐。德意志銀行追蹤逾100檔在美國境外註冊的指數股票型基金(ETF)發現，外國投資人過去兩週大舉逢低買進美股，買進力道為今年最強，顯示流向美股的資金也是支撐美元的重要因素。
隨著風險偏好回升、避險需求降溫，日元兌美元走貶。美元兌日元上漲0.4%，報159.905日元兌1美元，中止連續四個交易日下跌。
分析師指出，若AI相關資產再度遭到拋售，避險買盤與資金匯回日本可能支撐日元，但日元兌其他貨幣的升勢，可能比兌美元更為明顯。
澳幣兌美元則大致持平。澳洲10月就業人數連續第二個月減少，失業率升至五年高點，強化市場對當地利率可能已觸頂的看法。
三菱日聯金融集團(MUFG)資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman表示，市場大幅上調對聯準會升息的預期，正對大宗商品價格及相關貨幣形成壓力。
瑞銀考量澳洲通膨仍高，以及勞動與房市情況惡化，將澳洲央行首次降息時間預測，由明年11月提前至8月，並將預估降息次數由兩次增加至三次。
英鎊兌美元升值0.1%，報1英鎊兌1.3162美元，但英鎊兌歐元則從20個月高點回落。投資人仍看好英國利率前景，同時對歐洲2027年多場重要選舉可能為歐元帶來的阻力保持警戒。
加密貨幣方面，受風險偏好改善帶動，比特幣上漲2.5%，報63,870美元，脫離上週日觸及的四個月低點62,026美元。

paras_en: The dollar fell against most major currencies on Thursday (the 19th), pausing its recent rally. The upcoming IPO of AI company Anthropic lifted market risk appetite and weakened dollar buying pressure. However, hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials and the latest meeting minutes still support expectations of further rate hikes, keeping the dollar index near a 19‑month high.
In the late‑day US equity session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, slipped 0.2% to 103.65, while the euro rose 0.2% to $1.1002.
The dollar index this week reached its highest level since April 2, 2025, when President Trump announced large‑scale tariff measures that triggered selling pressure on US assets.

The current dollar rally began on November 10, when US inflation data came in above expectations, prompting investors to increase bets on tighter Fed policy. Fed Governor Christopher Waller called for more aggressive action against inflation, and the minutes from the Oct. 27‑28 meeting showed policymakers growing increasingly concerned that further tightening may be needed.

Shaun Osborne, chief FX strategist at Canada’s BMO Capital Markets, said: “The dollar has already risen a lot in recent weeks, and I think the current exchange rates already reflect much of the upside.”

He added that for dollar bulls to push rates higher in the short term they would need stronger conviction or more positive news, and he attributed the dollar’s partial pullback to improved market risk sentiment ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.
Anthropic’s IPO was priced above its initial marketing range, lifting Nasdaq futures on Thursday and raising expectations for its market debut, which revived sentiment toward AI‑related stocks.

Barclays analysts argue that fiscal stimulus and robust AI‑related capital spending show the US economy is resilient, suggesting output may be running above potential for longer, keeping rates high – a backdrop that benefits the dollar.

Despite recent tech‑stock sell‑offs, the dollar continued to attract inflows. Deutsche Bank, tracking over 100 offshore‑registered ETFs, found foreign investors bought US equities in large volumes over the past two weeks – the strongest buying this year – indicating that capital flowing into US stocks also underpins the dollar.
With risk appetite recovering and hedging demand easing, the yen weakened against the dollar. The USD/JPY rose 0.4% to 159.905 yen per dollar, ending a four‑day decline.

Analysts note that if AI‑related assets face another sell‑off, safe‑haven buying and capital returning to Japan could support the yen, but the yen’s gains against other currencies may be more pronounced than against the dollar.

The Australian dollar was roughly flat versus the US dollar. October employment in Australia fell for the second consecutive month, pushing the unemployment rate to a five‑year high and reinforcing market views that local rates may have peaked.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said the market’s sharp upgrade of expectations for Fed rate hikes is putting pressure on commodity prices and related currencies.

UBS, considering still‑elevated Australian inflation and worsening labour and housing conditions, moved its forecast for the Reserve Bank of Australia’s first rate cut from November next year to August and increased the expected number of cuts from two to three.

The pound rose 0.1% to $1.3162, but the GBP/EUR slipped from a 20‑month peak. Investors remain bullish on UK rate prospects while staying cautious about the potential drag on the euro from several major European elections slated for 2027.
In crypto, improved risk appetite lifted Bitcoin 2.5% to $63,870, pulling it out of the four‑month low of $62,026 hit last Sunday.

items.title_en: NTD: Central Bank Actively Adjusts FX Market Volatility, Depreciation Turns to Appreciation, Closing at 32.942
paras: 台北股匯市遭逢雙殺壓力，除了金管會自明(20)日起再祭出五大穩定股市措施，包括重啟「有條件禁空令」，中央銀行也積極調節匯市波動，終場收在32.942元，升值0.5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值則縮至22.63億美元。
新台幣今日以32.96元、貶值1.3分開出後，最低一度貶至33.04元，但觸及33元心理大關後貶勢並未擴大，收盤前15分鐘更轉升，收在32.942元，高低價差1.2角。
由於成交值較昨日見收斂，法人解讀資金拋補大鬥法已稍微緩解，不過，尚未見到台股的止跌訊號，匯市能否就此守住無形的33元防線，仍受到市場密切關注。
觀察主要亞幣，日元貶值約0.3%，新台幣收升0.02%，星元和人民幣微幅波動不到0.05%，韓元升0.1%左右，泰銖升0.2%，而美元指數小跌近0.1%。
法人指出，聯準會內部鷹派釋出12月應考慮升息2碼的訊息，令市場風險意識持續提高，同時，後黃仁勳時代的AI投資焦慮高漲，AI估值調整壓力持續消化中。
值得留意的是，獨立新創AI Anthropic將在台灣時間今日晚上掛牌，掛牌行情成另一個左右市場信心的重要焦點。
paras_en: Taipei stock and forex markets faced double‑kill pressure. Starting today (20th), the Financial Supervisory Commission rolled out five major measures to stabilise the stock market, including re‑instating the "conditional short‑selling ban". The central bank also actively adjusted FX market volatility, ending the session at 32.942, up 0.5 points, while the turnover of Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms shrank to $2.263 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened today at 32.96, down 1.3 points, fell to a low of 33.04, but after hitting the psychological 33‑level the decline did not deepen. In the last 15 minutes before close it turned higher, finishing at 32.942, with a daily range of 1.2 jiao.

Because turnover narrowed compared with yesterday, institutional investors interpret that the large‑scale fund‑outflow battle has eased somewhat, yet no clear bottoming signal has appeared for the Taiwan stock market. Whether the FX market can now hold the intangible 33‑level barrier remains under close market scrutiny.

Looking at major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen weakened about 0.3%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.02%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan fluctuated less than 0.05%, the Korean won rose roughly 0.1%, the Thai baht rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index slipped nearly 0.1%.

Institutions note that hawkish voices inside the Fed have signalled that a 20‑basis‑point rate hike should be considered in December, raising market risk awareness. At the same time, AI‑investment anxiety is soaring in the post‑Jensen Huang era, and pressure from AI valuation adjustments continues to be digested.
Worth noting is that the independent AI startup Anthropic will list tonight Taiwan time, and its debut price will become another key focus influencing market confidence.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda told parliament that, given the still‑accommodative financial environment, rate hikes should continue, emphasizing the need to keep core inflation near the 2% target and to adjust monetary easing appropriately as the economy, prices and financial conditions evolve, providing support for the yen and pulling USD/JPY down to a low of 159.11.

Subsequent U.S. October data showed that building permits – a leading indicator of future construction activity – fell 7.4% to an annualized 1.295 million units, while housing starts rose 9.9% to an annualized 1.309 million, beating forecasts. The NAHB survey reported the October existing‑home‑sales‑to‑inventory index slipped 4.7% to 63, the lowest since the series began in 2001. Fed governors Waller and Bahl expressed that more aggressive action is needed to combat inflation, and the Fed’s October meeting minutes revealed that policymakers unanimously agreed to keep rates unchanged for now, though some members suggested a 50‑basis‑point hike, lifting USD/JPY to a high of 159.65. The dollar‑yen pair is expected to face resistance at 159.50‑70 and support at 158.60‑80 today.
EUR/USD

Australia’s Q3 wage‑price index rose 1.1% yesterday, the biggest gain since the end of 2023, indicating a still‑tight labour market. The data are lagging and have not yet reflected the impact of the fifth rate hike this month. In the interest‑rate swap market, the probability of the Reserve Bank of New Zealand raising rates by 25 bps is seen at 80%, with a cumulative 85 bps increase priced in for the end of next year. Conversely, the odds that Australia’s rates have peaked are estimated at 73%, with about 24 bps of cuts priced in for the end of next year. These dynamics have pushed the Australian dollar toward a ten‑month low and the New Zealand dollar to its lowest since March 2020, weighing on the euro‑dollar pair, which is capped by a ceiling at 1.0999.

Euro‑area October HICP rose 0.5% month‑on‑month, slightly above expectations, and 4.0% year‑on‑year, in line with forecasts. Four sources disclosed that ECB policymakers plan to discuss raising the minimum reserve requirement for euro‑area banks to 2% next week. The ECB’s financial‑stability report noted that market pressure should prompt France to take self‑disciplinary measures on its high‑debt issue, signalling no rush to intervene in member‑state debt problems, which has pushed EUR/USD down to a low of 1.0952. The pair is expected to face resistance at 1.0975‑95 and support at 1.0900‑20 today.
GBP/USD

The UK released its October CPI on Wednesday, up 3.6% year‑on‑year – a one‑year high – while core inflation and services price inflation held steady at 2.8% and 3.7% respectively, below expectations of a rise. This reduces the probability of a Bank of England rate hike next month and has pulled sterling down from a high of 1.3212. BOE Governor Andrew Bailey said the labour market appears less slack but still has some idle capacity, widening the pound’s fall to a low of 1.3132. The pound‑dollar pair is expected to face resistance at 1.3150‑70 and support at 1.3060‑80 today.
